6c10feab.title: Solution Engineer (Automotive)
6c10feab.description:
**Job Title:** Solution Engineer – Facility Engineering

**Job Level:** E1 / E2

**Department:** Facility Solution Engineering

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Purpose**

The **Solution Engineer** will design, cost, and execute technical solutions for facility utilities, HVAC, thermal, and fluid systems. This role bridges customer requirements with engineering execution by developing detailed technical proposals, preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQ), selecting core equipment, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams and vendors to support business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design \& Engineering Sizing**

* Perform thermal, fluid, and pressure\-drop calculations to size equipment, piping, pumps, chillers, and cooling towers.
* Design and evaluate support structures, skids, and facility layouts for chilled water, cooling water, fuel, and HVAC systems.
* Use 2D/3D drafting tools (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, SketchUp) to prepare process flow diagrams, P\&IDs, and layout schemes.

**Proposal Development \& Costing**

* Analyze customer RFQs, tender specifications, and technical scope requirements.
* Develop detailed Bills of Materials (BOM) and Bills of Quantities (BOQ) along with line\-item cost estimates.
* Prepare comprehensive technical proposals, bidding documents, and value\-engineered alternatives.

**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with suppliers to evaluate component options, obtain commercial offers, and assist in technical negotiations.
* Conduct site visits to assess customer facilities, gather field data, and attend pre\-bid technical clarification meetings.
* Coordinate with internal engineering, sales, procurement, and project execution teams to deliver viable solutions.

**Qualifications \& Prerequisites**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience in facility solution engineering, utility sales support, or thermal/fluid system design.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Core Technical:** Strong grasp of fluid mechanics, heat transfer, psychrometrics, pump selection, and pipe sizing.
* **Software:** Proficiency in **AutoCAD (2D Drafting)** and MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Experience with **SolidWorks** or **SketchUp** is a plus.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Understanding of BOQ/BOM preparation, vendor negotiation, and cost optimization strategies.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to present technical solutions to client stakeholders.
* **Attributes:** Self\-driven, collaborative, detail\-oriented, and customer\-focused.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

dfed0bf8.title: Member of Applied AI - Architect
dfed0bf8.description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will serve as
 **a hands\-on senior technical architect** 
 on the Applied AI Engineering team, owning the end\-to\-end design and delivery of AI\-driven business transformation projects.
   

  

 You'll work closely with pre\-sales teams to scope technical integration and implementation strategies, translating business requirements into architectural solutions. Once opportunities move to post\-sales, you'll own the detailed technical designs from original scoping documents and drive execution including hands\-on coding to build proofs\-of\-concept, custom integrations, and solution prototypes that validate technical feasibility.
   

  

 As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross\-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain\-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent\-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.
   

  

 This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands\-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world business impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Customer\-facing: 20\-40% working directly with customers
* Design \& Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.
* Integrate Systems: Connect AI agents with external platforms (e.g., CRMs, APIs, databases) for seamless workflow automation.
* Optimize Performance: Tune prompts, logic, and agent configurations for accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Own Requirements: Partner with customers to deeply understand their needs and translate them into technical agent specifications.
* Prototype \& Iterate: Lead live demos, build rapid proof\-of\-concepts, and refine solutions through customer feedback.
* Lead Execution: Define project plans, align internal teams, and ensure timely delivery of deployments.
* Advise Customers: Act as a trusted technical advisor on AI agent architecture, performance, and long\-term scalability.


**What You Bring**
* Experience: 7\+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer\-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).

ffb779e1.title: Data Domain Architect Senior Associate
ffb779e1.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

We have an exciting opportunity for you to enhance your career in Data \& Analytics, contributing to innovative banking solutions.


As a Data Domain Architect Associate within Consumer \& Community Banking \- Business Banking division, You will be responsible for working collaboratively to develop solutions to obtain and extract large customer data sets which meet business inclusion and exclusion criteria. You will ensure integrity of process by creating samples which are representative of the entire customer base, through extensive auditing and validation. Through the application of highly technical skills, you will create customer data sample files across all lines of business which are used to generate insights to better our customer's experiences.


**Job responsibilities**

* Leverage a variety of analytical and statistical applications (SQL, Snowflake,Python etc.) to describe, analyze, and interpret complex data sets.
* Identify customer interactions and events across a variety of channels (calls, branch, online, emails etc.) to target customers for survey invitations.
* Wrangle, prepare and validate data from multiple diverse data sources in preparation for file creation.
* Independently deliver recurring data files in accordance with client SLAs.
* Facilitate requirement definitions, design, testing, and code implementation for survey data to measure customer satisfaction.
* Partner closely and collaborate with data management teams, strategy teams, and other analytics resources across multiple functional teams.
* Construct process documentation and workflow capture.
* Aid in presentations summarizing code logic and data sourcing.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree required in Operations Research, Market Research, or a related field with 6\+ years of related experience
* Proficient with SQL, Python and other analysis tools.
* Experience using common relational database systems; i.e., Snowflake, SQL and Oracle database
* Strong written and oral communication skills; ability to communicate effectively with all levels of management and partners from a variety of business functions
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* AWS, Databricks or other Cloud Data Warehouse experience

Morgan and Chase brands. fdb89ba0.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
fdb89ba0.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

**About BCG Platinion**
 BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time\-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading\-edge tech platforms, at scale.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Salesforce Architect who can lead and deliver complex Salesforce solutions for our clients in various industries. You will define the Salesforce strategy, architecture, integration, development, and security of multiple Salesforce applications across sales, service, and marketing clouds. You will also work with senior client stakeholders, manage project teams, and collaborate with other vendors.

* Manage project teams, vendors, budgets, timelines, and quality assurance activities
* Stay updated on the latest trends and developments in Salesforce and CRM domains
* Develop trust\-based relationships with clients as a trusted C\-level advisor
* Lead the delivery of high\-quality products that exceed client expectations
* Support the professional development of your team members through coaching and feedback
* Contribute to the intellectual capital of the firm by creating knowledge documents on a specific content platform


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 8 t0 14 years of experience in IT Architecture, Technology transformation, Salesforce architecture and development
* Salesforce Application Architect and System Architect certifications
* Experience in leading and delivering complex Salesforce solutions using sales cloud, marketing cloud, service cloud, and marketing cloud for at least 5\-10 clients in target industries
* Experience in integrating Salesforce applications with external data platforms (Data lakes, etc.), ERP systems (Manufacturing industry), CBS systems (Financial industry), LMS systems (Financial industry), analytical systems (Tableau, etc.), messaging systems (Kafka, etc.), and public cloud platforms (one major public cloud)
* Experience in working with Indian clients and organizations
* Strong understanding of CRM market and competitors (SFDC, MS Dynamics, Oracle, Zoho, etc.)
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Ability to travel as per requirement


 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**Customer Success \& Enablement**

55c049d7.description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms**

*Job Description \| Finance Technology*

**Position Summary**


We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Senior Lead, Anaplan Solutions \& Planning Platforms** to lead the implementation, support, and strategic expansion of enterprise planning solutions across Finance. This role will own delivery outcomes across Anaplan Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR support, Income Statement planning, Data Hub architecture, integrations, UX reporting, and future planning modernization capabilities.


The ideal candidate is not only a strong Anaplan expert, but also a capability builder who can establish delivery discipline, mentor a team, strengthen governance, and translate business priorities into scalable, controlled, and user\-friendly planning solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**


1\. **Required Technical Skills \& Experience**

* Deep expertise in Anaplan solution architecture, model building, Data Hub design, ALM, UX development, and deployment management, with a proven ability to design scalable, high\-performing enterprise planning solutions.
* Strong functional knowledge of FP\&A, workforce planning, budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and financial data management, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable planning capabilities.
* Experience leading end\-to\-end implementation and enhancement of enterprise planning platforms, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, governance, and production support.
* Proven ability to design and manage enterprise data integrations, leveraging APIs, SQL, and data analysis techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability across planning ecosystems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills with expertise in reporting, analytics, controls, access management, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, complemented by experience working within Agile delivery frameworks and modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence stakeholders, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning efficiency, data quality, and business outcomes.
 **2\.****Leadership \& Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing Anaplan delivery team comprising model builders, analysts, engineers, and solution SMEs.
* Establish clear ways of working across backlog management, sprint execution, release planning, quality reviews, documentation, and production support.
* Coach team members on Anaplan best practices, model design, data management, performance optimization, and business engagement.
* Create a sustainable capability model with role clarity, cross\-training, succession planning, and measurable skill maturity.
 **3****. Strategy, Roadmap \& Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Finance, FP\&A, HR, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Technology stakeholders to define priorities, business outcomes, and delivery roadmap.
* Translate business needs into scalable Anaplan solutions that improve forecasting, workforce planning, scenario analysis, expense planning, and management reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by providing clear options, risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Lead prioritization forums and drive alignment across business value, regulatory needs, capacity, and technical feasibility.
 **3\. Solution Architecture \& Delivery Ownership**

* Own end\-to\-end design and delivery of enterprise Anaplan capabilities across Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR, Income Statement planning, cost center planning, and scenario modeling.
* Design scalable multi\-model architectures using Data Hub, ALM, controlled data flows, modular design principles, and reusable planning components.
* Ensure models are performant, auditable, maintainable, secure, and aligned to Anaplan and enterprise technology standards.
* Oversee requirements, design, build, testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and post\-production stabilization.
 **4\. Platform Operations, Controls \& Data Quality**

* Strengthen production support, incident management, release governance, access controls, and operational risk management.
* Establish data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and error\-handling processes across inbound and outbound planning data.
* Drive improvements in platform stability, data accuracy, business adoption, user experience, and planning cycle efficiency.
* Maintain strong documentation for model architecture, data lineage, integrations, controls, release records, and support procedures.
 **5\. Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify planning processes, automate manual activities, enhance reporting visibility, and improve self\-service capability.
* Evaluate and apply modern planning practices including predictive planning, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled insights, and integration automation where appropriate.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational precision, accountability, and business\-value driven delivery.
 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise planning, financial systems, EPM platforms, FP\&A technology, or related finance technology domains.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Anaplan implementation, model building, and solution architecture experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale planning implementations from concept through production deployment.
* Strong working knowledge of FP\&A, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, management reporting, cost center planning, and financial data structures.
* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner credentials preferred.
* Experience with Hyperion, Oracle EPM, OneStream, SAP BPC, Workday, Power BI, SQL, ETL tools, APIs, or enterprise data platforms is good to have
* Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory planning, risk, CCAR, SOX\-controlled environments, or large global enterprises.
* Strong Agile delivery experience and familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, change management, and release governance.
* Experience designing Data Hub architecture, integrations, validation routines, and controlled data flows.
* Demonstrated experience building, mentoring, and leading technical teams.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Job Description**

 Planisware Architect

**About SLB**
 SLB is the world's leading provider of technology for reservoir characterization, drilling, production, and processing to the oil and gas industry. Working in more than 85 countries and employing approximately 100,000 people who represent over 140 nationalities, SLB supplies the industry's most comprehensive range of products and services, from exploration through production and integrated pore\-to\-pipeline solutions for hydrocarbon recovery that optimize reservoir performance. Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we’re looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co\-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts.
   

  

**About SLB India Technology Center**
 SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Advanced technologies are key enablers to this and encompass all aspects of business systems, including the organization platform and processes. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars – IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization.
   

  

**About Role**
 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.
   

  

 The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in\-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors.
   

  

 This role will work closely with the Scrum team on defining / change requirements and align with the development team (L3, vendors) for technical design and effort validation. Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co\-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of standard as well as customized Planisware solution to address Project Management needs/Stakeholders
* Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals.
* Obtain business requirements and use cases / user stories from Product and Service Delivery, Supply, Distribution and Operation Planning Domains for all enhancements. Validate all such requirements and articulate to the L3 teams
* Customization Framework: Define best practices and frameworks for customizing Planisware to meet the evolving needs of the business.
* Integration Strategy: Develop and implement integration strategies to connect Planisware with other enterprise systems. Optimizing the API calls to minimize the performance issues \& Cost.
* Governance \& Best Practices: Establish governance around Planisware usage, ensuring the platform is optimized for scalability, security, and performance.
* Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, ensuring efficient use of resources, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.
* Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high\-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
* Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests.
* Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary


 Release Management
   

  

* Assist the Technical Team in the design and development of the release management process
* Expertise in various PLW modules, including Oscar and PMGo modules.
* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process
* Periodically reports performance metric dashboard for releases handled. Communicate release details and schedules to the Domains as required


**Essential Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of overall support/development experience, of which 5 \+ years on Planisware.
* Planisware Certification – Specialist OR Expert
* 4\+ years in Change and Release Management
* 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP.NET, etc.
* Good understanding of consuming APIs through Single Page Application (SPA).
* Good exposure to database technologies like Oracle, MS SQL Server, etc.


**Key competencies**
* In\-depth knowledge of the change management process working on the change and release module
* Should have a thorough understanding and working knowledge of ITIL processes including Application Change and Release Management
* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments
* Very good understanding around building Planisware based solution and Integration / data migration processes
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
* Good knowledge of Azure IaaS / PaaS
* Very good experience of version management.
* Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process
* Advanced knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle
* Preferred experience in Oil \& Gas industry (though not mandatory)


**Other Skills And Abilities**
* Self\-driven, Proactive, Systems Thinking
* Open to travel abroad and in India
* Comfortable working occasional extended hours demanded by emergency release
* Exposure to Performance Tuning (Tuning concepts \- indexes, segments, partitions, query tuning) of database systems would be an added advantage
* Works well with all personality types


**SLB as an employer**
 As a leading employer in our industry, SLB is proud to offer a highly competitive package of base and incentive compensation as well as a comprehensive benefits program designed to support the health, wellness and financial security of our employees and their families. SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. **In This Role, You Will**
* Govern the security architecture of enterprise cloud and hybrid environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and OCI platforms.
* Conduct cloud security architecture reviews covering Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), network segmentation, micro\-segmentation, and Zero Trust security models.
* Partner with Cloud Management Office, enterprise architecture, security, and engineering teams to integrate security requirements into cloud design and architecture decisions.
* Define and implement cloud security standards, architectural patterns, governance controls, and security guardrails.
* Embed security requirements into Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation frameworks.
* Collaborate with compliance and risk stakeholders to ensure cloud solutions meet regulatory and security requirements.
* Evaluate emerging cloud services, container platforms, serverless technologies, and AI\-enabled solutions while providing architectural guidance and security recommendations.
* Serve as the primary security architecture liaison between enterprise architecture, security governance, control validation, IT security, and business stakeholders.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level objectives (SLOs) for cloud architecture initiatives.
* Lead architecture governance reviews, risk assessments, threat modeling exercises, and solution validation activities.
* Mentor security, architecture, cloud, and engineering teams on secure cloud operations and cloud security best practices.
* Stay current on cloud provider roadmaps, threat landscape developments, regulatory requirements, and industry security standards.


**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in information security and cybersecurity architecture.
* 8\+ years of experience securing enterprise cloud environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and/or OCI.
* Proven experience designing and governing cloud security architectures for large\-scale enterprise deployments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cloud architecture security reviews and evaluating security controls against cloud frameworks and assurance programs.
* Experience implementing and governing cloud security requirements within DevSecOps environments.
* Strong expertise in cloud security architecture, threat modeling, risk management, and security governance.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, compliance, risk, audit, and operational stakeholders.
* Experience managing, mentoring, and guiding architecture, engineering, or validation teams.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for improving the security posture of cloud environments.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.


**These Will Help You Succeed**
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure, including Landing Zones, Azure Policy, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Palo Alto Cortex, API Security, DSPM, Zscaler and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Google Cloud Platform security services and governance frameworks.
* Experience with container platforms including AKS, EKS, and GKE.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes security, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh technologies.
* Strong cloud networking expertise including VNet/VPC design, hub\-and\-spoke architectures, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, firewall controls, and micro\-segmentation.
* Expertise in Zero Trust Architecture, IAM, PIM, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and SIEM/SOAR integrations.
* Experience with security and compliance frameworks including PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF 2\.0, NIST SP 800\-53, and Cyber Essentials Plus.
* Experience using Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates, CloudFormation, GitOps, and CI/CD security controls.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, Bash, and cloud automation practices.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Leadership experience coaching and mentoring architects, engineers, and security practitioners.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK).
* Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\) or equivalent AWS Certified Security – Specialty or GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer certification.
* Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\).
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\).
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\) or equivalent AWS or GCP Professional Architect certification.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

d826a163.title: Senior Solution Architect — Sales AI Applications
d826a163.description:
NVIDIA pioneers computer graphics, gaming, AI, and accelerated computing. We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect with full\-stack software engineering experience to join our team and play an important role in developing Sales AI applications. This position offers the opportunity to design, build, and evolve solutions that bring generative AI and intelligent workflows into everyday sales experiences.
   

  

 You will work across the application stack and collaborate with Product, AI and machine learning, Data, Security, Solution Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions used globally.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Collaborate with application teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack solutions for enterprise sales workflows.
* Guide technical solutions across front\-end, back\-end, APIs, data services, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Translate product requirements and business needs into secure, maintainable solutions and intuitive user experiences.
* Integrate generative AI models, AI services, APIs, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows into production applications.
* Design application architectures that support performance, availability, observability, security, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead technical design discussions, compare implementation approaches, make informed architecture decisions, and evaluate emerging technologies.
* Improve engineering practices for testing, code quality, continuous integration and delivery, monitoring, documentation, and production readiness. Investigate complex issues and develop solutions that improve reliability and user experience.
* Mentor engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to engineering standards and collaborative team practices.


**What We Need To See**
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is encouraged.
* 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and operating production applications.
* Experience developing full\-stack applications with modern front\-end, back\-end, and web application technologies.
* Proficiency in one or more languages or frameworks, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, React, Node.js, or similar technologies.
* Experience designing APIs, distributed applications, data services, enterprise integrations, scalable cloud applications, databases, and messaging systems.
* Experience integrating AI or machine learning capabilities through APIs, models, retrieval systems, or AI services.
* Knowledge of software architecture, system design, security, testing, observability, and production operations.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, make informed engineering decisions, communicate with technical and non\-technical teams, and mentor engineers.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience building generative AI applications, including AI assistants, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, AI productivity tools, Python\-based AI services, large language model APIs, vector databases, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation.
* Experience combining traditional software systems with AI models and data pipelines and progressing AI capabilities from prototype through production.
* Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, security, or enterprise AI governance.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, microservices, infrastructure as code, DevOps practices, application performance, reliability, scalability, observability, cloud cost efficiency, or globally distributed engineering teams.


 NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you’re creative, eager to tackle meaningful business problems, and enjoy having fun, NVIDIA is the perfect company to work for.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Experience with large\-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi\-tenancy, and multi\-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.

ec3b25e5.title: Engineering & Delivery Lead - Data Services
ec3b25e5.description:
We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands\-on
 **SVP – Engineering \& Delivery Lead (Data Services)** 
 to join our technology leadership team in Pune. In this critical engineering role, you will serve as the
 **Platform Tech Lead** 
 and take end\-to\-end ownership of the technical delivery,
 **architectural alignment** 
 , and global engineering execution for our strategic Data Services platforms.
   

  

 This is a senior software engineering leadership and technical delivery role designed for a seasoned software/data engineer with a proven track record of managing engineering teams and technically steering agile workstreams. In this role, you will hold
 **direct line management responsibility** 
 for distributed agile engineering pods, providing people leadership, talent development, and technical oversight.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving the technical execution of key initiatives, including modernizing our core data services, scaling our data lakehouse infrastructure, and engineering critical regulatory\-driven technology programs, compliance commitments, and enterprise technology mandates. You will own team capacity planning, hiring, talent development, and performance evaluations.
   

  

 A core expectation of this role is an
 **AI\-First Thinking Mindset** 
 . You will actively champion and drive the adoption of generative AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, and other developer productivity assistants) to significantly accelerate software delivery, automate testing, and improve code quality across your teams, adapting seamlessly to the enterprise\-approved tools available within our network. You will ensure that all engineering deliverables strictly align with our target architecture, enforce rigorous code and design standards, and maintain hands\-on technical oversight and architectural alignment across multiple global agile engineering workstreams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Engineering Leadership \& People Management
* Engineering Line Management: Manage, hire, develop, and conduct performance evaluations for a distributed, multi\-location team of software and data engineers, ensuring continuous talent growth and high team engagement.
* Agile Pod Delivery: Provide hands\-on technical leadership and functional management across agile engineering pods, driving daily sprint execution, code reviews, and architectural alignment.
* AI\-First Software Delivery: Champion and drive an AI\-first developer culture. Promote the adoption of generative AI coding assistants and modern productivity tools to accelerate software development, automate unit test generation, and streamline code refactoring across your engineering teams.
* End\-to\-End Technical Delivery: Take full accountability for the technical delivery of data services, real\-time pipelines, and platform integrations from inception to production deployment.
* Engineering Excellence: Foster a culture of high\-quality software engineering, enforcing rigorous unit testing, automated integration testing, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices.
* Architectural Alignment \& Technical Governance
* Architectural Adherence: Ensure all engineering deliverables and system designs strictly align with the target enterprise architecture, design patterns, and future\-state roadmaps defined by the Enterprise Architecture teams.
* Technical Design \& Review: Lead the technical implementation design of platform components, APIs, and data access patterns, ensuring they are optimized for high performance, low latency, and scalability.
* Technical Debt Management: Proactively identify and remediate technical debt, ensuring the platform remains maintainable, resilient, and sustainable.
* Security \& Governance by Design: Enforce strict data security, row/column\-level masking, and access control policies (e.g., Apache Ranger) within all engineered solutions.
* Database Security Compliance: Ensure that all data storage and pipeline implementations adhere to rigorous enterprise security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), secure connection protocols, and continuous database auditing.
* Platform Modernization \& API Engineering
* Data Pipeline Engineering: Oversee the engineering of robust, high\-throughput data pipelines across hybrid relational databases and modern cloud\-native lakehouses.
* API \& Microservices Development: Lead the development of standardized, secure, and resilient microservices (primarily Java/Spring Boot) to support high\-concurrency data consumption and AI\-driven use cases.
* Regulatory \& Mandatory Engineering Commitments
* Regulatory Engineering: Lead the technical execution of critical regulatory\-driven technology programs, compliance commitments, and enterprise technology mandates, ensuring engineered solutions are robust, compliant, and delivered within strict timelines.
* Audit\-Ready Standards: Ensure all technical documentation, system designs, and deployment pipelines meet rigorous internal audit and regulatory compliance standards.


 Technology Skills \& Competencies
   

  

**Required Technical Skillsets (Must Be Hands\-on)**
* Java Software Engineering (Core Competence): Advanced, hands\-on expertise in Java and enterprise Java frameworks (specifically Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA). Proven track record of developing high\-throughput, low\-latency, and highly secure backend microservices, custom data connectors, and distributed processing modules.
* Database \& NoSQL Engineering (Must\-Have): Deep, hands\-on experience designing, developing, and tuning enterprise\-scale relational databases (Oracle and SQL Server) and document\-based NoSQL stores (MongoDB). Strong proficiency in writing and optimizing complex queries (advanced SQL), managing indexing strategies, and designing high\-availability, clustered, and replicated database architectures (e.g., replica sets, multi\-node clustering).
* AI\-First Developer Skills (Must\-Have): Proven capability and hands\-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to accelerate software delivery, write code, generate tests, and optimize development workflows.
* API \& Integration Engineering: Proven experience designing and building secure, high\-performance REST/gRPC APIs, message queues (specifically Apache Kafka or TIBCO EMS), and secure data access patterns.
* CI/CD \& DevOps (Must\-Have): Hands\-on experience building, configuring, and maintaining deployment pipelines in Linux environments. Strong expertise with enterprise CI/CD platforms (specifically Harness or Jenkins), containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, and RedHat OpenShift), and enterprise workload automation/job scheduling (Autosys).


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skillsets**
* Data Virtualization \& Federation: Technical and architectural understanding of query federation engines and data virtualization platforms, such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill.
* Agentic AI \& LLM Engineering: Conceptual or hands\-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks and libraries (such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, or equivalent) for building autonomous AI agents, prompt engineering, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Distributed Data Processing: Familiarity or hands\-on experience with distributed compute engines, specifically Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink.
* Modern Lakehouse Platforms: Experience working with cloud\-native enterprise data lakehouse or warehouse platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).
* Data Quality Automation: Familiarity with automated data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt, Soda, or Deequ).
* Programming Languages: Familiarity with Python or Scala for auxiliary data manipulation, scripting, or data science integrations.


 Leadership \& Methodology
   

  

* Agile Engineering Delivery: Strong experience running engineering delivery within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, managing sprint closures, and leveraging enterprise tracking tools (specifically Jira and Confluence) to drive visibility and alignment.
* Talent Management (Must\-Have): Proven experience managing hiring, professional development, and performance reviews for technical teams across distributed or international offices.
* Test Strategy Design: Proven track record of designing multi\-layered testing strategies (unit, integration, regression, system, and regression parallel runs for migrations).


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Total Engineering Experience: Minimum 12\-15\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, data engineering, or platform development within a large\-scale, highly regulated environment (preferably financial services).
* Technical Leadership \& Line Management: Minimum 5\+ years of direct experience as an engineering line manager, principal engineer, or platform lead with direct people management responsibilities over software/data engineering teams, including experience leading teams across distributed or multi\-location hubs.
* Agile Delivery: Proven track record of driving technical delivery within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, managing sprint commitments, and collaborating closely with product owners.
* Location Requirement: Based in or willing to relocate to Pune, India (hiring hub), with a proven capability of collaborating with, influencing, and aligning global engineering teams across multiple time zones
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.

903fd586.title: Solutions Engineer
903fd586.description:
**Meet the Team**
 Join our dynamic Solutions Engineer team at Cisco, where you’ll collaborate with experienced professionals passionate about driving technical sales excellence and enhancing customer engagement. Together, we innovate and deliver cutting\-edge solutions that empower our customers and partners to achieve their business goals. Be part of a supportive environment that fosters growth, teamwork, and meaningful contributions to Cisco’s success.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Technical Sales Professional, you will own the Cisco brand with customers and partners by delivering technical solutions that address their business needs. You will collaborate closely with the account team and connected sales teams to ensure customer success, serving as a trusted technical advisor.
   

  

* Leverage deep knowledge of Cisco’s portfolio, including specialized and architectural perspectives. Drive penetration through cross\-selling and up\-selling while displacing competition. Be responsible for the technical relationship with customers and partners.
* Lead engagements with IT and business decision\-makers, understand customer environments and market dynamics, and translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Focus on landing opportunities and expanding within accounts. Participate actively in customer strategic planning.
* Provide valuable feedback to Business Executives and sales teams on strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Lead deals through the technical sales process, design and present solutions based on customer requirements, manage virtual sales support teams, and leverage tools to support deals.
* Increase revenue by converting opportunities to closed deals, displace competitors to grow market share, and expand the customer base quarterly.


**What You'll Do**
* Develop multi\-year strategic plans integrating Cisco’s portfolio for customers.
* Deepen expertise by combining domain knowledge with cross\-architectural solutions.
* Shape technical strategies for senior executives.
* Align customer business objectives with industry knowledge to create comprehensive solutions.
* Lead demand generation and enablement initiatives.
* Identify latent customer needs and showcase cross\-architecture solutions.
* Lead impactful demonstrations emphasizing business outcomes driven by Cisco solutions.
* Use competitive intelligence to differentiate Cisco offerings.
* Mobilize broad stakeholder networks to drive transformative synergies and optimize relationships.
* Direct virtual and extended sales teams toward continuous improvement and oversee educational programs.
* Demonstrate agility by adapting strategies in response to market disruptions.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree with 8\+ years of related experience, or an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) with related experience.
* Proficiency in Cisco networking technologies and solutions, including SD\-WAN, MPLS, LAN, Cloud, Unified Communications (UC), and Security.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of cloud computing platforms and services.
* Expertise in Cisco’s cloud portfolio to design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with network automation tools to streamline deployment, management, and operational efficiency of network and collaboration solutions.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

aaeaf695.title: Project solution Engineer
aaeaf695.description:
**Company Description** 
 Cognex Corporation has been a leader in advanced machine vision for over 40 years, helping manufacturing and distribution organizations automate processes to become faster, smarter, and more efficient. Its innovative vision sensors and systems address critical challenges across industries including automotive, consumer electronics, and packaged goods, delivering high performance and reliability. Cognex leverages AI to make its tools highly capable yet easier to deploy, enabling factories and warehouses to improve quality and productivity without requiring deep technical expertise. The company is headquartered near Boston, USA, operates in more than 30 countries, and serves over 30,000 customers worldwide.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Project Solution Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting machine vision solutions that meet customer requirements and align with Cognex standards. This full\-time, on\-site role in Bengaluru involves reviewing customer applications, selecting appropriate hardware and software, developing proof\-of\-concept demonstrations, and configuring systems for deployment. The position includes collaborating closely with sales teams, application engineers, and customer stakeholders to define project scope, create technical proposals, and ensure successful installation and commissioning. The Project Solution Engineer also provides technical training, documentation, and post\-deployment support, while continuously refining solutions based on performance data and customer feedback. Travel to customer sites may be required for project execution, troubleshooting, and relationship management.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Experience in machine vision, industrial automation, or robotics, with the ability to design and deploy integrated hardware and software solutions.
* Strong skills in system integration, including sensors, controllers, networking, and industrial communication protocols (such as Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, or Modbus).
* Proficiency in technical problem\-solving, diagnostics, and root\-cause analysis for complex automated systems.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, layouts, and mechanical or electrical schematics for solution design and deployment.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams and presenting solutions to customers.
* Experience managing technical projects, including requirements gathering, planning, documentation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced degrees or relevant certifications are a plus.
* Background in manufacturing or logistics environments is beneficial, especially in automated inspection, quality control, or material handling systems.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bengaluru and travel to customer locations as needed.

8aafbec9.title: Distinguished Engineer, Switch Architect
8aafbec9.description:
**About Marvell**


Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.


At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**


Marvell’s Cloud Data Center Group designs and delivers the advanced interconnect architectures that serve as the backbone of modern computing. Within this group, the Teralynx Switch Architecture Team defines the architecture of Marvell’s future\-forward switch ASICs—solutions engineered for hyperscale cloud environments, massive east\-west traffic, and the unique challenges of AI workloads.  

  

This team shapes product definition, behavioral modeling, device performance modeling, and architectural validation. We work at the bleeding edge of semiconductor innovation, influencing industry standards and enabling the compute fabrics of tomorrow.**What You Can Expect**


Why Marvell  

* Work at the center of AI\-driven semiconductor innovation, shaping architectures that industry leaders will rely on for the next decade.
* Influence standards and ecosystems that define where the industry is going—not just where it is.
* Collaborate with high\-caliber engineering peers solving some of the largest\-scale data networking challenges on earth.
* Thrive in an environment where ideas are explored deeply, innovation is rewarded, and technical excellence drives impact.

As a **Distinguished Engineer**, you will be one of the most influential technical minds in Marvell’s switch strategy. You will own major architectural decisions that directly impact how hyperscale operators and AI clusters connect, scale, and evolve.


Your work will help guide the future direction of Marvell technology—delivering breakthroughs in performance, efficiency, and scalability that shape entire markets.

**What You Can Expect**

* Define architecture for Marvell’s **next\-generation AI networking switch ASICs** designed for hyperscale cloud and ML/AI\-driven workloads.
* Anticipate and analyze emerging technology trends, influencing long\-term roadmap and architectural direction.
* Contribute to the development of industry standards including **Ultra Ethernet** and **Ultra Accelerator Link (UAL)**.
* Create and maintain architectural and performance models to evaluate trade\-offs in latency, power, bandwidth, and scalability.
* Collaborate with silicon, software, systems, and product teams to drive holistic architectural alignment.
* Document architecture concepts, specifications, performance analyses, and modeling methodologies.
* Represent Marvell in standards bodies, research consortiums, and strategic customer discussions.
* Provide architectural mentorship and leadership to engineering teams across the organization.

**What We're Looking For**

* BS with **15\+ years**, MS with **10\+ years**, or PhD with **8\+ years** in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Extensive experience defining and architecting **large\-scale ASICs** and complex networking semiconductor architectures.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep architectural understanding of:
	+ High\-speed interconnects and Ethernet protocols
	+ Traffic management architectures and packet processing
	+ Scaling networks in AI training and inference fabrics
* Proven hands\-on experience with **performance modeling**, simulation, and architectural trade\-off analysis.
* Proficiency in **C/C\+\+**, **Python**, and modeling environments.
* Experience contributing to or leading standards development is highly valued.

**Leadership \& Influence**

* Strong conceptual thinking and architectural innovation capabilities.
* Collaborative leadership style; ability to work across silicon, systems, software, and customer engineering teams.
* Exceptional communication skills; able to convey complex architectural concepts to technical and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring and influencing engineering talent and product direction.

7e01cb7e.description:
**Meet The Team**
 Join our dynamic Solutions Engineer team at Cisco, where you will collaborate with seasoned professionals dedicated to driving technical sales perfection and improving customer engagement. Together, we innovate and deliver cutting\-edge solutions that empower our customers and partners to achieve their business goals. Be part of a supportive environment that fosters growth, teamwork, and impactful contributions to Cisco’s success.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Solutions Engineer you will orchestrate involvement of all technical activities and resources, holding accountabilities for all opportunities within assigned account(s) and provide architectural perspective across the Cisco product portfolio, including software and services.
   

  

* Technical sales professional serving as a Technology/Product/Solution consultant.
* Technical orchestrator for an array of Cisco resources, primary responsibility for ensuring successful completion of each pitstop from a technical perspective in the lifecycle selling motion.
* Provides technical information and design/implementation guidance in concert with Cisco Architecture Seller team(s).
* Collaborates with the Account Manager on the customer account plan(s), jointly ensuring customer success.
* Work with internal teams to orchestrate right solutions against customer requirements with competitive positioning
* Educate customer on Cisco differentiation and establish technical leadership of Cisco as a brand.
* Field role that serves as a Technology expert across solutions preferably within a multi\-domain architecture approach.
* Build relationship with Engineering Teams, field teams, architecture team, Business Units (BUs), Partners and customers.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree with 8\+ years of related engineering/technical sales experience, or an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) with related experience.
* Deep proficiency across Cisco’s multi\-domain portfolio, including SD\-WAN, MPLS, LAN, Cloud, Unified Communications (UC), and Security, to provide comprehensive architectural perspectives.
* Proven experience serving as a technology consultant, handling the configuration, technical validation, and end\-to\-end orchestration of complex telecom and ICT solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage all technical activities, resources, and evaluation milestones within a structured, value\-driven sales lifecycle.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of major cloud computing platforms, with specific expertise in Cisco’s cloud portfolio to design scalable, secure, and cost\-effective multi\-domain solutions.
* Ability to build highly tailored technical architectures that counter competitive technologies and clearly demonstrate Cisco’s brand differentiation to clients.
* Hands\-on experience using network automation and orchestration tools to optimize deployment, management, and operational efficiency across network and collaboration solutions.
* Strong track record of building technical relationships across diverse teams, including Engineering, Account Management, Business Units (BUs), and external Partners.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

We are looking for a
 **Quality Solution Architect** 
 who will be responsible for covering customers' business goals and technical tasks. The role is for those who are enthusiastic about engineering solutions and technologies. * Expertise in web application/web services architectures, relational and non\-relational data storage specifics, and cross\-cutting concerns such as security, monitoring, and caching

4b06c13a.title: DWP Solution Consultant
4b06c13a.description:
**JOB PURPOSE** 




 The DWP Solution Consultant is a technical presales and solutioning specialist who designs winning, deliverable, and commercially viable solutions across Teceze's Digital Workplace (DWP) portfolio, delivered under the ONEWORK™ experience\-led operating model. The role sits at the intersection of Sales, Delivery, and the Centre of Excellence (COE) — translating client requirements into differentiated solution designs across Intelligent Service Desk, Endpoint Engineering \& Modern Management, Digital Experience (DEX) \& Proactive Operations, AI \& Intelligent Automation, M365/Teams \& Copilot, Field \& Deskside Services, Device Lifecycle \& Depot Services, Smart Workplace \& AV, and Workplace Security \& Compliance. The Solution Consultant plays a critical role in RFP/RFI responses, client workshops, solution architecture, effort estimation and pricing, and in building reusable IP that strengthens Teceze's competitive position in the DWP market.
 



**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. Presales \& Solution Design** 



* Partner with Sales to qualify opportunities and understand client pain points, current\-state environment, and desired business/experience outcomes.
* Design end\-to\-end DWP solutions spanning one or more sub\-towers (Service Desk, Endpoint/UEM, DEX/AIOps, AI \& Automation, Collaboration, Field Services, Device Lifecycle, Smart Workplace/AV, Security) tailored to client needs.
* Lead or contribute to RFP/RFI/RFQ responses — solution narrative, service descriptions, org design, transition approach, staffing plans, and technology architecture.
* Develop solution architecture and technical diagrams articulating the ONEWORK™ operating model — shared data, integration, governance, knowledge, and AI orchestration across the client's environment.
* Build and deliver compelling client\-facing presentations, solution demonstrations, and proofs of concept (POCs) / proofs of value (POVs).
* Represent Teceze in client workshops, discovery sessions, and due\-diligence calls, acting as the credible technical voice of the DWP practice.



**2\. Commercial \& Effort Estimation** 



* Develop effort estimation, staffing pyramids, and delivery models (dedicated pods vs. shared pools, onshore/nearshore/offshore, follow\-the\-sun) for proposed solutions.
* Work with Sales and Finance to build costing and pricing models across commercial constructs — per\-user, per\-device, per\-ticket, managed service, and outcome\-based pricing.
* Support commercial negotiations by clarifying solution scope, assumptions, dependencies, and pricing rationale to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure proposed solutions meet target gross margin and deliverability thresholds before submission, escalating risks to the Practice Head where needed.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Centre of Excellence (COE) Contribution** 



* Stay current on the DWP platform ecosystem (ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune/Autopilot, Nexthink/1E, Azure OpenAI/Copilot Studio, UiPath/Power Automate, Entra ID/Defender, Blancco, and similar) and emerging trends in AI\-first, experience\-led workplace services.
* Contribute to the DWP Centre of Excellence (COE) by building reusable solution accelerators, reference architectures, estimation models, and demo assets.
* Champion innovation and differentiation — conversational AI, agentic automation, self\-heal AIOps, Copilot readiness/adoption, and governed/responsible AI practices — in every solution design.
* Ensure all proposed solutions align with XLA \+ SLA governance, ITIL 4 process design, persona\-based service design, and shift\-left economics.
* Mentor junior presales/solutions team members and support their technical and commercial upskilling.



**4\. Transition \& Delivery Enablement** 



* Support a smooth handover from Sales/Solutioning into Transition and Service Delivery, ensuring the solution as sold is deliverable as designed.
* Participate in solution walkthroughs and knowledge transfer with the Transition Manager and Service Delivery leads at deal closure.
* Validate that transition timelines (e.g., 4–6 week service desk stand\-up, two\-week field/depot mobilization) and staffing assumptions built into the proposal are realistic and achievable.
* Provide ongoing solution support during early life of an account, addressing scope clarifications and design queries as they arise.



**5\. Marketing \& Thought Leadership Support**
