**You've Got What It Takes If You Have...**
 4\+ years of Technical Program Management or project leadership experience in a SaaS or software engineering environment.
   

  

 Experience coordinating cross\-functional programs across engineering, product, and design teams in an agile environment.
   

  

 Enough technical fluency to follow engineering conversations, ask good questions, and communicate technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Solid understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and program management fundamentals including planning, risk tracking, and dependency management.
   

  

 Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can translate complex information into clear, concise updates for a range of audiences.
   

  

 Experience working with distributed teams across time zones.
   

  

 A data\-driven mindset with the ability to track and report on program metrics in a meaningful way.
   

  

 Strong organizational skills and a bias toward action — you follow through, close loops, and keep things moving.
   

  

**Extra dose of awesome if you have...**
 Experience delivering programs that involve generative AI, LLM integration, or intelligent automation within enterprise SaaS products.
   

  

 Familiarity with MLOps tooling, model evaluation frameworks, or AI observability practices.
   

  

 Background in HR technology, learning \& development platforms, or talent management systems.
   

  

 Prior knowledge of the Cornerstone platform and ecosystem.
   

  

 PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent program management certification
   

  

**Our Culture**
 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

da17e001.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud Infrastructure - DevOps
da17e001.description:
NVIDIA is the world leader in computer graphics, artificial intelligence, and accelerated computing. For over 25 years, we have been at the forefront of research and engineering around the greatest advances in technology. Our history of innovation drives us to solve the worlds hardest problems.
   

  

 NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure/DevOps Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain continuous integration and delivery pipelines .
* Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large\-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self\-service consumption of resources.
* Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
* Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
* Being a technical resource, develop, re\-define and document standard methodologies to share with internal teams Support Research \& Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements .


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering fields with at least 8 years work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center architecture.
* 5\+ Years of Design, implement and maintain large scale HPC/AI clusters with monitoring, logging and alerting Manage Linux job/workload schedulers and orchestration tools.
* Knowledge of HPC and AI solution technologies from CPU’s and GPU’s to high speed interconnects and supporting software.
* Direct design, implementation and management experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Experience with job scheduling workloads and orchestration technologies such as Slurm, Kubernetes and Singularity.
* Excellent knowledge of Windows and Linux (Redhat/CentOS and Ubuntu) networking (sockets, firewalld, iptables, wireshark, etc.) and internals, ACLs and OS level security protection and common protocols e.g. TCP, DHCP, DNS, etc.
* Experience with multiple storage solutions such as Lustre, GPFS, zfs and xfs. Familiarity with newer and emerging storage technologies.
* Python programming and bash scripting experience.
* Comfortable with automation and configuration management tools including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/Chef, etc.
* Deep knowledge of Networking Protocols like InfiniBand, Ethernet Deep understanding and experience with virtual systems (for example VMware, Hyper\-V, KVM, or Citrix).
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are critical.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

**About Boomi and What Makes Us Special**





 Are you ready to work at a fast\-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award\-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800\+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world\-class people and industry\-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.
 




 Our Technical Architecture team within Professional Services are experts in package customization and integration as well as total, end\-to\-end solutions in targeted industry segments. After thorough consultation with our customers and careful analysis, we develop new IT systems or replace existing systems that support customers’ strategic, operational and financial goals.
 



 Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a
 **Technical Architect** 
 in our
 **Professional Services team** 
 in
 **Bangalore, India.** 




  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
   
 



 As a Technical Architect you will provide the leadership, facilitation, analysis and design tasks required for the development of an enterprise's solution architecture. You will create deliverables that help develop target\-state guidance (reusable standards, guidelines, individual parts and configurations) for evolving the solution architecture and infrastructure, in order to enable business strategy and deliver targeted business outcomes.
 



 Your core duties will include, but are not limited to:  
 


* Work closely with customers and partners to gather requirements and design complex business application and data integration solutions.
* Translate business processes and requirements into technical integration requirements and designs.

* Provide architecture\-level infrastructure recommendations, configuration, and sizing requirements to support the Boomi product suite.

* Recommend best practices for implementing, managing, and governing integrations using the Boomi AtomSphere integration platform.
* Define and promote the adoption of best practices of Boomi's products across the internal and external user community.



  
 



**Essential Requirements** 



* Master's or Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field of study.
* 15 or more years of combined experience in at least three disciplines: business, information, solution or technical architecture, application development, middleware, business analysis, database management, strategic and operational planning in a multitier environment.

* Experience in building AI automation solutions using LLMs, RAG and AI Agents

* Demonstratable experience and/or certification in one or more of TOGAF, ArchiMate, SAFe, COBIT, Zachman and Design Thinking.
* General knowledge of common CRM/SFA/ERP business systems (such as SAP, NetSuite, Workday, ServiceNow, AD, etc.) and processes (such as lead to cash, requisitions, order management, etc.)
* General knowledge of key application infrastructure components such as VMware, storage (NAS, SAN, SMB), Java JVM, networking (firewall, load balancing, proxies).
* Knowledge of security aspects considered at the architecture level and its application to all layers of the technology stack (such as payload encryption, protocol encryption, access controls, authentication/authorisation, data classification and network/infrastructure security).



  
 



**Desirable Requirements** 



* Familiarity with other visual\-based integration middleware platforms and Software\-as\-a\-Service technologies.
* Database skills including SQL, data modelling, and databases (e.g. MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and non\-relational databases (e.g. NoSQL).
* Messaging skills including JMS (e.g. ActiveMQ, MQSeries, OracleAQ).
* Development/scripting skills with Java, Groovy, JavaScript.
* Experience with containerisation and associated tooling, such as Docker, Kubernetes etc.
* Knowledge of Data Management and API Management (e.g. GraphQL alongside REST).
* Experience with performance tuning, capacity planning, monitoring metrics, etc.
* Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and CI/CD practices (familiarity with tools such as JIRA, ADO, Git, etc.)



  
 



**What you’ll achieve** 




 As an Architect you will work closely with customers to understand their requirements, assist with project scoping and build innovative solutions to solve business problems. You’ll have the opportunity to learn more about the Boomi platform and grow your skills as an architect/consultant. You will be joining Boomi at an exciting time of growth and innovation.
 



  
 








**Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi.** 
 We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.

* Architect retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and semantic search solutions, selecting appropriate vector search, hybrid ranking, and grounding strategies for enterprise knowledge bases.

 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization of industry and security experts, engineers, data scientists, architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. We partner with strategic customers to deliver industry\-specific solutions and measurable outcomes powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

 The AI Business Solutions team within ISD helps customers maximize value from Dynamics 365, M365 , Copilots and the Microsoft Cloud by
 **co\-engineering GenAI and agentic solutions** 
 that accelerate adoption, automate workflows, and unlock new business capabilities. We work in
 **rapid, iterative delivery cycles** 
 to move from ambiguous problem → working prototype → production\-ready solution
   

  

 Our organization drives customer value across digital and AI transformation through repeatable and customized solutions. We build with a growth mindset and an inclusive culture, and we deliver
 **responsible AI** 
 solutions designed for
 **security, compliance, and operational readiness**
 This role goes beyond traditional consulting. FDEs operate at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and customer delivery, working in fast‑paced, iterative cycles to translate ambiguous requirements into working software, integrate with real customer environments, and own outcomes through deployment and stabilization.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond and we apply these values when delivering AI solutions that customers can trust.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Embed with customer stakeholders to understand business workflows, constraints, and success metrics; translate ambiguous needs into clear requirements, solution hypotheses, and sprint deliverables for GenAI/agentic scenarios.
* Design and implement agentic and GenAI solutions on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Dynamics 365, M365 Copilots, Power Platform, Azure) including integrations, APIs, and automations that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Prototype rapidly, then harden to production: build POCs for agentic workflows (multi\-step tasks, tool\-use, orchestration), validate with users, and evolve production\-ready implementations with testing, monitoring, and secure deployment patterns.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery from architecture through implementation: define build/test specifications, create eval and quality gates for GenAI outputs, and produce operational guides/runbooks for reliability, safety, and maintainability.
* Identify and mitigate business/technical risks specific to AI systems (data access, prompt injection, hallucinations, privacy, compliance, latency, cost); propose safeguards and fallback behaviors for agentic flows.
* Support deployment and live stabilization: troubleshoot integrations and model behavior in real environments, iterate quickly, and ensure successful go\-live with clear ownership, monitoring, and incident playbooks.
* Balance platform configuration with extensibility to maximize speed and maintainability. Co\-engineer with customer teams to ensure knowledge transfer, documentation, and reusable patterns. Drive delivery plans across the full lifecycle—discovery, build, eval, deployment, and operations—accounting for dependencies across data, security, and enterprise systems.
* Build agentic workflows that invoke tools/APIs safely (function calling patterns), with guardrails, validation, and auditability.
* Implement evaluation strategies (offline/online) to measure output quality, groundedness, safety, and business impact.
* Capture repeatable assets (templates, reference architectures, accelerators) and share feedback loops with internal teams.


**Other**
* Embody our culture and values

* 18\+ years’ experience delivering enterprise\-scale solutions on Microsoft platforms (Dynamics 365 / M365 Copilot/ Power Platform / Azure), including integration, security, and deployment in customer environments.

* Experience building or extending solutions involving Copilots, AI‑assisted workflows, or intelligent automation is a strong plus.
* Certifications and/or experience in Azure Solutions, Dynamics 365, M365 Copilot and Power Platform; exposure to Azure AI services and GenAI solution patterns is a strong plus.
* Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, and operational readiness (observability, incident response) strongly preferred—especially for AI systems.

0a089531.title: Solutions Engineer
0a089531.description:
**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both** 



  


 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 


  


**What the week contains** 



  


 Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.
 


  


**The uncomfortable part** 



  


 Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.
 


  


**Looking for** 



  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales engineering or a customer\-facing technical role
* Enough hands\-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience


  


 Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.
 


  


*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer\-facing engineering roles here.*

The role governs Guidewire Policy Center and related capabilities, provides strategic guidance to delivery teams, drives modernization initiatives, and influences technology investments aligned to business priorities

Requires in\-depth logical and practical knowledge in Domain Architecture and basic knowledge of related job disciplines. * 4\-6 years in Guidewire Policy Center \- Auto, Home, PNC
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, or related field
* Experience defining architecture roadmaps and technology strategy
* Knowledge of cloud transformation, APIs, integrations, and data architecture

* Experience supporting large\-scale transformation programs
* Fluent English communication skills

* Delivers single domain architecture solutions and executes continuous domain level architecture improvement roadmap.
* Actively supports design and steering of a continuous delivery pipeline.
* Plans Architecture runway for a full solution and fosters built\-in quality for entire solution.
* Establishes and supports definition of Non\-Functional requirements


**🔧 Technical \& Business Skills**
* Guidewire PolicyCenter
* Cloud Architecture AWS
* Domain Architecture and Enterprise Architecture
* API Architecture \& Integration Architecture
* Data Architecture
* Technology Roadmapping
* Continuous Delivery / Architecture Runway

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive benefits package

* Training \& Development

3b4e32fe.description:
**Job Description**
 As a recognized authority and leading contributor within their practice, this senior\-level consulting position provides consistent high quality and innovative solution leadership to a project team. Provides expertise to project team(s) ensuring high quality, integrated software solutions within constraints of time and budget.
   

  

 Analyzes business needs to help ensure Oracle solution meets the customer’s objectives by combining industry best practices, product knowledge, and business acumen. Exercises judgment and business acumen in selecting methods and techniques to deliver technical solutions on non\-routine and very complex aspects of applications and technology installations. Provides direction to project teams, and effectively influences customer leadership on key decisions. Resolves complex customer issues by recommending and implementing solutions. Demonstrates expertise in multiple business processes across two or more product families or ability to architect and design technology solutions encompassing multiple products and make decisions based on impact across the stack.
   

  

 8\+ years of experience relevant to this position including 5 years of consulting experience. Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience preferred. Product or technical expertise relevant to practice focus. Ability to communicate effectively. Ability to build rapport with team members and clients.
   

  

**Overview of ACS Technical Team:**
* Is an acknowledged authority within the Oracle NetSuite Global Business Unit (GBU), providing subject matter expertise and consulting services to the GBU's most significant, strategic, and most challenging customers around the globe.
* Supports customers' full life cycle, including services targeted to ensure the success of complex, large\-scale NetSuite implementations and post\-go\-live services to ensure the ongoing success of NetSuite solutions, mitigating the technical risks commonly seen for large\-scale and/or complex implementations.


**Responsibilities**
 As a trusted advisor, technical solution architect, and technical consultant, the TECHNICAL ARCHITECT role provides technical architect consulting services, including:
   

  

* Holistic technical design reviews
* Performance and scalability
* Optimization of integrations and NetSuite customizations
* Data management consultation and guidance
* Consultative guidance on ERP leading practices


 Leveraging deep technical experience, TECHNICAL ARCHITECTs analyze customers' business \& technical requirements to ensure appropriate and long\-term scalable use of NetSuite and work with partners to implement recommendations.
   

  

 TECHNICAL ARCHITECTs work with their customers and partners to review technical feature gaps that may arise and devise appropriate solutions across the NetSuite ecosystem.
   

  

 TECHNICAL ARCHITECTs lead customers and partners through the appropriate use of NetSuite environments, design and optimizing considerations for integrations and customizations, and practices for successful data migrations.
   

  

 TECHNICAL ARCHITECTs form the core of the ACS Technical Team subject\-matter expertise and are leveraged across accounts when required. TECHNICAL ARCHITECTs are the thought leaders within their area of expertise and work with the Product organization to ensure new product technical changes and capabilities are understood and adopted by customers and partners.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications include:**
* Ability to be self\-directed, multi\-task, and lead others with minimal supervision
* Minimum of 5 years of technical consulting experience
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Adept at getting hands\-on with technology and presenting concepts effectively at various levels within a customer's and/or partner's organization
* Strong analytical skills
* Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following: performance, integrations, technical architecture or software development
* Demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end business process flows


**Hands on Experience in the following areas are required:**
* Performance and scalability of ERP systems (Oracle EBS, Oracle Fusion, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, NetSuite)
* Orchestrating and executing load and performance testing
* Tuning of SQL statements
* ODBC / JDBC data extraction strategy, design and tuning
* Data Modeling
* SaaS/Cloud architectures
* Oracle database architecture
* Architecting and tuning integrations (with products like Oracle Data Integrator, Boomi, Mulesoft, Celigo, Workato or Snaplogic)
* ETL tools and techniques
* Software development life\-cycles (SDLC)
* Release management and/or Agile scrum master experience
* Developing and optimizing NetSuite SuiteScript, JavaScript. NetSuite SuiteCloud Developer
* Developing and optimizing NetSuite SuiteTalk, SOAP integrations, or REST integrations


**Experience in the following areas is desired:**
**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC4
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.

 As an
 **Enterprise Architect – Generative \& Agentic AI** 
 , you will make an impact by
 **defining and delivering enterprise\-scale AI architectures that accelerate digital transformation and business innovation** 
 . You will be a valued member of the
 **AI \& Digital Engineering team** 
 and work collaboratively with
 **C\-suite stakeholders, AI strategists, solution architects, and engineering teams** 
 to build scalable, secure, and future\-ready AI ecosystems.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Define and own the enterprise AI architecture strategy, aligning with business objectives and transformation initiatives
* Design and implement Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including multi\-agent architectures and orchestration frameworks
* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture, from LLM selection and context engineering through to deployment and integration
* Drive innovation through PoCs, pilots, and reusable accelerators, ensuring measurable business outcomes
* Establish and enforce AI governance, compliance, and ethical AI frameworks to enable responsible adoption

 .

* Deep understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman)

Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and innovative ideas to this role.

e8bd9702.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
e8bd9702.description:
**Role: Senior Cloud Engineer**
 Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
   

  

 Department: Product Development
   

  

**About GHX**
 GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network — the world’s largest cloud\-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. Its solutions span electronic trading, procurement automation, inventory and contract management, business intelligence, and data synchronization, helping healthcare organizations improve productivity and focus more on patient care. Over the years, GHX has enabled significant cost savings for the industry and continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI\-driven capabilities.
   

  

 Website: https://www.ghx.com/
   

  

 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ghx/
   

  

**About Role**
 The Senior Cloud Engineer leads the design, implementation, and operations of the organization’s cloud infrastructure. This role is responsible for complex projects, high\-level architectural planning, and making strategic technology decisions that support scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization. Acting as a technical leader, the Senior Cloud Engineer provides mentorship to junior and mid\-level engineers while driving innovation, resiliency, and compliance in cloud environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Design and Implementation**
* Lead the design and implementation of cloud\-native architectures and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Oversee cloud engineering projects, ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, and cost\-effective.
* Contribute to high\-level architectural planning and strategic decision\-making around technology adoption.
* Review and approve design proposals, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, and automation workflows.
* Identify risks in design and implementation plans and develop mitigation strategies.


**Management and Maintenance**
* Oversee the management of cloud resources across multiple platforms and environments.
* Lead performance tuning, scaling strategies, and cost optimization efforts.
* Make strategic decisions regarding upgrades, cloud service adoption, and configuration changes.
* Ensure adherence to operational standards, SLAs, and governance policies.


**Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution**
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for complex, high\-impact issues across cloud platforms.
* Oversee incident response and problem resolution by guiding junior and mid\-level engineers.
* Develop and implement proactive strategies to reduce recurring issues and increase platform reliability.
* Serve as the final escalation point for cloud\-related technical problems.


**Security and Compliance**
* Lead cloud security initiatives, including IAM strategy, data encryption, logging, monitoring, and incident response.
* Oversee vulnerability management and implement security automation in cloud environments.
* Ensure compliance with industry frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI, HIPAA, ISO 27001, or NIST.
* Develop strategies to improve security posture and enforce governance across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments.


**Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning**
* Lead cloud disaster recovery and continuity planning efforts across critical workloads.
* Conduct advanced risk assessments, failover testing, and recovery exercises.
* Make strategic decisions about resilience design, including multi\-region, high availability, and backup solutions.
* Drive improvements to disaster recovery strategies to align with evolving business needs.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in cloud engineering or IT infrastructure, with increasing technical leadership responsibilities.
* Deep expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and familiarity with multi\-cloud environments.
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and automation tools (e.g., GitHub/GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines).
* Advanced knowledge of networking, container orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS/ECS), and operating systems.
* Hands\-on experience with VMware virtualization (vSphere/ESXi) including vSAN\-based hyperconverged storage design, deployment, and operations.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Hyper\-V failover clustering using Storage Spaces Direct (S2D) for hyperconverged infrastructure.
* Proven experience with cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks.
* Demonstrated leadership, mentorship, and project management skills.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and strategic thinking abilities.

We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe \- who rely on smart, secure healthcare\-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions.

876926c9.title: AWS Cloud Architect
876926c9.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!
   

  

**Overview**
 The AWS Cloud Architect is a senior strategic and technical leadership role responsible for the design, governance, and evolution of enterprise cloud architecture across multi\-region AWS environments. This position will drive the assessment and migration of legacy on\-premises workloads to cloud\-native architectures, define and enforce infrastructure and delivery standards, and govern hybrid environments that span both on\-premises data centres and AWS. Operating within the payments industry, the successful candidate will ensure all architectural decisions are aligned with organisational objectives, PCI DSS compliance obligations, and industry best practices. The role requires strong collaboration with engineering teams, operations, security, and executive stakeholders to define scalable, secure, and cost\-effective cloud strategies — while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural governance across the broader engineering organisation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the cloud architecture strategy across multi\-region AWS environments, ensuring alignment with business objectives, security requirements, and compliance obligations.
* Lead the planning and execution of cloud migration programmes, taking legacy on\-premises workloads through lift\-and\-shift and progressively re\-architecting them to cloud\-native patterns.
* Architect and govern hybrid environments spanning on\-premises data centres and AWS, including private connectivity, identity federation, hybrid DNS, and unified observability.
* Design highly available multi\-region architectures incorporating active\-active and active\-passive configurations, automated failover, global load balancing, and data replication strategies.
* Define infrastructure\-as\-code standards using Terraform and Terragrunt, including module governance, policy\-as\-code guardrails, and multi\-account state management strategies.
* Architect and oversee GitLab\-based CI/CD platforms, setting delivery standards for infrastructure and application pipelines across multiple engineering teams.
* Ensure all cloud architecture meets the compliance and regulatory requirements of the payments industry, including PCI DSS, SOC 2, and regional data sovereignty obligations.

* Lead architecture review processes, providing technical governance across major engineering initiatives and acting as the final escalation point for complex infrastructure decisions.
* Mentor and uplift senior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a culture of architectural rigour, security\-first thinking, and continuous improvement.


**Essential Skills**
 Cloud Architecture \& AWS
   

  

* 8\+ years of cloud infrastructure or platform engineering experience, with at least 4 years in a senior architect or principal engineer capacity.

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional certification required; additional AWS specialty certifications (Networking, Security) highly regarded.
* Proven ability to produce clear, comprehensive architecture documentation and communicate architectural decisions to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.


 Multi\-Region Architecture
   

  

* Demonstrated experience designing and operating multi\-region AWS architectures including active\-active deployments, Route 53 global traffic management, and automated region failover.
* Deep knowledge of multi\-region data replication patterns including Aurora Global Clusters, DynamoDB Global Tables, and S3 Cross\-Region Replication.
* Experience defining and testing Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO), including regular DR testing and chaos engineering programmes.
* Understanding of data sovereignty, regulatory, and latency considerations that inform multi\-region deployment decisions.


 Migration: Lift \& Shift to Cloud Native

* Proficiency with migration frameworks such as the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and the 6 Rs (Rehost, Replatform, Repurchase, Refactor, Retire, Retain).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS migration tooling: Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS), Schema Conversion Tool (SCT), and DataSync.
* Experience migrating databases and messaging systems to managed AWS equivalents (e.g., Oracle to Aurora, on\-premises Kafka to Amazon MSK, RabbitMQ to Amazon MQ).
* Skilled at containerising legacy applications and progressively decomposing monolithic architectures into microservices deployed on EKS.


 Hybrid On\-Premises \& Cloud Environments
   

  

* Extensive experience designing hybrid cloud architectures integrating on\-premises infrastructure with AWS via Direct Connect and Site\-to\-Site VPN.
* Strong understanding of hybrid identity management including Active Directory integration, AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO), and federated authentication.
* Experience with hybrid DNS architecture using Route 53 Resolver, hybrid networking via Transit Gateway, and unified monitoring across on\-premises and cloud segments.

 Infrastructure as Code — Terraform \& Terragrunt

 GitLab, Argo \& CI/CD
   

  

* Strong GitLab platform experience including pipeline architecture, GitLab Runners at scale, environment governance, and integration with AWS deployment targets.
* Argo CD experience for GitOps\-driven delivery and Argo Rollouts for progressive deployment strategies including blue/green and canary releases.
* Ability to define and govern platform\-wide CI/CD standards, enabling multiple product teams to deliver independently, safely, and consistently.


 Istio \& Service Mesh
   

  

* Architect\-level Istio expertise covering control plane configuration, sidecar injection, traffic policies, fault injection, and observability stack integration.
* Experience defining mTLS, RBAC, and Istio AuthorizationPolicies to enforce zero\-trust service communication across Kubernetes namespaces and clusters.


 Payments Industry \& Compliance
   

  

* 3\+ years of architecture experience within the payments industry or an equivalent regulated financial services environment.
* Deep familiarity with PCI DSS requirements as applied to multi\-region cloud architecture, including network segmentation, encryption, audit logging, and access control.
* Experience engaging with auditors, compliance officers, and risk teams to evidence architectural controls and support certification programmes.

 Desirable Skills

* Familiarity with Argo Workflows and Argo Events for Kubernetes\-native pipeline orchestration and event\-driven automation.
* Observability stack experience, particularly in OpenTelemetry — particularly in multi\-region and hybrid contexts.
* Experience with HashiCorp Vault for enterprise secrets management including Kubernetes auth methods and dynamic credential issuance.
* Background in application security, threat modelling, or cloud security architecture using CSPM or CNAPP tooling.
* Exposure to additional cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) in a multi\-cloud or migration context.
* Experience with Helm or Kustomize for Kubernetes manifest management alongside Argo CD.


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Visionary yet pragmatic — able to define a compelling long\-term architectural direction while making sensible, incremental decisions that account for business realities and delivery constraints.
* Exceptional communicator with the gravitas and clarity to influence senior stakeholders and the ability to translate complex architectural concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership presence — inspires confidence in engineering teams, fosters psychological safety, and leads by example in terms of quality and rigour.
* Collaborative by nature, with a track record of building effective relationships across engineering, security, operations, product, and executive functions.
* Deep sense of ownership and accountability — takes responsibility for architectural outcomes and is proactive in identifying and addressing technical risk.
* Highly security\-conscious, with a natural inclination to embed compliance and security thinking into every architectural decision.
* Intellectually curious and a continuous learner, staying ahead of developments in cloud technology, payments regulation, and infrastructure tooling.


 Calm under pressure with strong judgment in high\-stakes incident situations and the ability to make well\-reasoned decisions with incomplete information.

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Solutions Manager based in India.**
 This role sits at the intersection of enterprise customer success, technical problem\-solving, and connectivity intelligence.
   

  

 You will serve as a trusted advisor to strategic customers, helping them maximize the value of sophisticated data and technology solutions.
   

  

 The position combines relationship management with hands\-on analysis across telecom, RF, networking, and machine learning domains.
   

  

 You will work closely with senior customer stakeholders, including directors and C\-level executives, to understand business priorities and deliver actionable insights.
   

  

 You will also collaborate with sales, product, data, and engineering teams to resolve complex challenges and identify opportunities for growth.
   

  

 AI\-enabled tools will be used to accelerate reporting, analysis, automation, and executive\-ready customer insights.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact in a fast\-moving, global environment where curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are highly valued.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of high\-value enterprise customers, building trusted relationships across business and technical teams.
* Develop and strengthen customer relationships through proactive engagement, strategic guidance, training, and ongoing support.
* Educate customers on product capabilities and help them achieve optimal adoption and value from the available data and technology solutions.
* Own customer\-facing technical and business issues, troubleshoot problems directly, and coordinate internal escalation and resolution when required.
* Engage effectively with directors and C\-level stakeholders, translating complex technical topics into clear business implications and recommendations.
* Partner with sales teams to monitor account health, identify expansion opportunities, and support pre\-sales activities.
* Represent the voice of the customer internally, advocating for customer requirements and influencing product and service improvements.
* Participate in customer meetings, including remote and onsite engagements, and maintain a high standard of communication and follow\-through.
* Apply strategic thinking to business, product, and technical challenges, helping customers turn connectivity data into actionable insights.
* Leverage AI tools to improve reporting, analysis, communication, market research, benchmarking, root\-cause investigation, and internal workflows.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive customer\-success, analytical, and operational processes and support the development of AI\-assisted dashboards, summaries, and executive outputs.
* Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to explore and implement AI\-driven use cases that increase customer value.
* Continuously expand technical knowledge and stay current with emerging technologies relevant to customers and the connectivity ecosystem.


**Requirements**
* 5–10 years of experience in enterprise\-level technology support, customer solutions, technical account management, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships across complex customer organizations and support senior stakeholders.
* Strong customer orientation, ownership mindset, urgency, and consistent follow\-through.
* Proven technical problem\-solving abilities, with the adaptability and curiosity to learn new technologies quickly.
* Experience supporting emerging products, services, or technologies as they enter new markets is strongly preferred.
* Strong data analytics capabilities, including experience with SQL, Tableau, advanced Excel functions, or comparable analytical tools.
* Experience visualizing and communicating large or complex datasets to demonstrate business value, product quality, or performance.
* Knowledge of data modeling, AI, and machine learning is desirable.
* Familiarity with internet, cellular, broadband, networking, and connectivity technologies and infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of RAN/RF technologies is required or strongly preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences at all organizational levels.
* Experience with technology\-based data or analytics products, including licensing or subscription models, is advantageous.
* Ability and willingness to travel regularly for customer meetings and professional or team events.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to understand the broader business context while managing detailed technical challenges.
* Experience supporting international customers or working in a global business environment is a plus.
* Technical program or project management experience is advantageous.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; a master's degree or international business education is a plus.


**Benefits**
* Remote work arrangement based in India, with flexibility to support a global customer base.
* Opportunity to work with enterprise customers and senior decision\-makers on complex technology and connectivity challenges.
* Exposure to telecom, RF, data analytics, AI/ML, networking, and emerging technology use cases.
* Collaborative environment spanning customer success, sales, product, data, and engineering teams.
* Opportunities to use AI and automation to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous learning and opportunities to expand technical, analytical, and strategic expertise.
* Potential for regular customer and industry travel, providing global exposure.
* Competitive compensation, with the final package determined based on experience, skills, education, geographic location, and business considerations.

 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
   

  

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
   

  

**Data Privacy Notice:** 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. * Identify, assess, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues, recommending practical solutions that improve efficiency and business outcomes.
* Provide technical guidance and leadership on assigned projects while collaborating with functional and technical teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities, take ownership of deliverables, and independently drive work through to completion.


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years of professional experience working with Oracle Cloud technologies, with substantial expertise in Oracle Cloud ERP and HCM.
* Expert\-level hands\-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Cloud ERP and HCM conversions, integrations, reporting, and technical solutions.
* Strong technical experience with Oracle Cloud ERP modules, particularly General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Expenses, Requisitions, and Purchasing, together with sufficient functional knowledge to understand and perform business transactions.

* Demonstrated programming experience with PL/SQL, advanced SQL, PeopleTools, and Oracle reporting technologies such as OTBI.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud security, approvals, SSO, data conversion, extracts, interfaces, and integration mechanisms.
* Experience with HDL, FBDI, Oracle REST and SOAP services; familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) is desirable.
* Strong experience developing reports and analytics using BI, OTBI, FRS, and Smart View.
* Experience with full lifecycle Oracle Cloud ERP and HCM implementations, including requirements, mapping, configuration, testing, training, cutover, and post\-go\-live support.
* Ability to understand and communicate Oracle Cloud ERP data models and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex issues and recommend scalable improvements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Demonstrated leadership, ownership, initiative, and ability to work independently while contributing positively to a broader team environment.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage shifting priorities while consistently meeting project commitments and deadlines.


**Benefits**
* Remote work arrangement within India.
* Opportunity to work on complex Oracle Cloud ERP and HCM transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to full lifecycle implementations, integrations, reporting, data conversions, security, and technical architecture.
* Significant ownership and responsibility for high\-impact technical deliverables.
* Collaborative consulting environment with opportunities to work closely with business and technical stakeholders.
* Opportunities to develop deeper expertise across Oracle Cloud technologies and enterprise transformation projects.
* Professional growth opportunities through exposure to complex client requirements and evolving cloud technologies.

f55ed1b8.title: Delivery Lead - Social & Search Ops
f55ed1b8.description:
* **Title** 
 : Delivery Lead — Social \& Search Ops
* **Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
* **Timings** 
 : 2\-11 pm



  





**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





**About the Role** 



* The Delivery Lead is the most senior role in the Social \& Search Operations team. You own the business — revenue, client outcomes, team performance, and the operating model that ties it all together.
* The team is structured in pods. Each pod is an Account Manager and one or more Associates. The AM owns the client relationship within their pod; the Associate owns campaign execution. You sit above all pods — accountable for what every pod delivers, for the commercial health of the client portfolio, and for the team's growth as professionals.
* This role exists because the team is scaling a significant mandate: taking over client\-facing campaign operations from a CS function, building toward full end\-to\-end ownership of enterprise recruitment advertising accounts. You will be the person who makes that transition work — credible with clients, trusted by your team, and commercially sharp with leadership.
* If you have spent your career executing campaigns for someone else's clients, this is not the right step. If you have owned outcomes — revenue targets, client retention, team results — and are ready to do that in a high\-growth environment, this is the role.



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own the revenue number for the Social \& Search Operations practice — renewals, upsells, and new business contributions
* Oversee all client pods — review account health across the portfolio, identify risk accounts, and intervene when needed
* Step in as the senior escalation point for client issues that exceed AM\-level resolution
* Present portfolio\-level performance and strategy to senior client stakeholders (C\-suite, VP\-level) on key accounts
* Lead quarterly business reviews for strategic accounts alongside or on behalf of AMs
* Partner with Sales on enterprise pitches and proposals — you bring the performance marketing credibility
* Hire, onboard, and develop AMs and Associates — including defining role clarity, setting performance expectations, and running structured feedback
* Define and enforce operating standards across pods: SLA compliance, reporting quality, campaign health benchmarks
* Work with leadership to define which accounts receive full client\-facing ownership vs. CS\-supported delivery
* Report monthly to senior leadership on capacity utilisation, revenue performance, and team health



  





**What You Will Own** 



* The revenue performance of the Social \& Search Operations practice
* Client retention across all pod accounts — renewal rate, satisfaction, escalation resolution
* Team structure and headcount decisions — you define when a new pod is needed and what profile to hire
* Cross\-pod quality and consistency — every client gets the same standard regardless of which pod they sit in
* The operating model — you update and enforce the RoE, SLAs, and pod protocols as the team evolves



  





**What You Bring** 



* 7–12 years in performance marketing, with the last 3\+ years in a leadership role that included direct revenue or P\&L accountability
* Proven track record of owning client relationships at a senior level — you have presented to and retained enterprise clients, not just supported someone who did
* Direct team management experience — you have hired, developed, and if necessary, exited people
* Deep hands\-on knowledge of paid media (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, programmatic) — you can review a campaign setup and identify problems, even if you no longer run accounts yourself
* Commercial acumen — you understand margin, renewal economics, upsell signals, and how to have a pricing or scope conversation with a client
* Experience running operations at scale — multiple clients, multiple channels, multiple team members simultaneously
* Strong executive communication — you are credible in a C\-suite room, and you can translate campaign performance into business outcomes without losing the audience
* Bangalore\-based or willing to relocate — this is a full\-time, in\-office leadership role



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Background in performance marketing agencies — multi\-client ops and client servicing discipline is a strong advantage
* Experience in recruitment advertising, employer branding, or HR tech — shortest ramp time into Joveo's client context
* P\&L ownership or revenue target accountability in a previous role — not just budget management
* Experience building or restructuring a team from the ground up
* Exposure to programmatic advertising platforms (DSPs, job boards, Joveo or similar)
* MBA or equivalent from a recognised institution — useful but never a substitute for the track record above



  





**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

bf7980e5.title: Technical Program Manager – Cloud Platform
bf7980e5.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Program Manager – Cloud Platform based in India.**
 This is a high\-impact technical program management role focused on driving the delivery and customer rollout of a growing cloud platform. You will coordinate complex initiatives across engineering, services, customer success, customers, and leadership to ensure programs move forward smoothly and on schedule. The role combines strong technical understanding with program ownership, product planning, documentation, and stakeholder management. You will help engineering teams stay focused by anticipating dependencies, securing decisions, and removing operational and coordination bottlenecks. You will also shape product roadmaps, prepare requirements, and ensure releases are clearly documented with relevant limitations and risks. Regular leadership reporting will give you visibility into delivery progress and strategic priorities. This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong program leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product, customers, and business leadership.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end planning, coordination, and delivery of major cloud platform initiatives, including new product experiences, customer rollouts, migrations, and other strategic programs.
* Partner closely with Customer Success teams and customers to plan deployment schedules, sequence activities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
* Coordinate across engineering, services, customers, and leadership to ensure programs remain aligned with agreed timelines, priorities, and objectives.
* Take ownership of cross\-functional coordination and operational overhead so engineering teams can remain focused on technical delivery.
* Build, maintain, and communicate a clear product and program roadmap aligned with business and customer priorities.
* Gather, consolidate, and structure product requirements from services teams, customers, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure customer context, use cases, requirements, and specifications are prepared ahead of engineering cycles to minimize delays and ambiguity.
* Secure leadership approvals and decisions in advance so engineering teams have the clarity and authorization needed to execute.
* Own and maintain release notes and product documentation for features and capabilities delivered.
* Work with engineering teams to document intended behavior, known limitations, release caveats, and potential misuse risks for each release.
* Monitor program progress, identify risks and dependencies, and proactively coordinate mitigation plans.
* Prepare and publish regular leadership updates, including monthly reports covering engineering achievements, delivery progress, risks, and upcoming priorities.
* Act as a trusted bridge between technical and non\-technical stakeholders, ensuring information flows clearly across the organization.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the cloud platform and engage hands\-on with the product when necessary to guide programs effectively.


**Requirements**
* 8\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or a closely related technical delivery discipline.
* Strong technical background with the ability to understand complex products, engage credibly with engineers, and effectively direct or coordinate technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to earn the confidence and respect of engineering teams through strong technical understanding, structured execution, and effective decision\-making.
* Expert proficiency with Azure DevOps, including backlogs, boards, releases, work tracking, and program or project management workflows.
* Proven experience managing deadline\-driven programs involving multiple stakeholder groups, including engineering, services, customers, and senior leadership.
* Excellent organizational, coordination, documentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines simultaneously.
* Comfortable getting hands\-on with technical products and understanding how features, integrations, and platform capabilities work in practice.
* Ability to translate customer and business needs into clear requirements and actionable engineering priorities.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working in a SaaS or cloud platform environment is highly desirable.
* Exposure to release management, product operations, technical writing, or cloud platform delivery is an advantage.
* Strong ownership mindset, proactive approach to problem\-solving, and ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to work remotely across India, with flexibility to transition to an onsite working model in the future if required.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote opportunity across India, with potential for an onsite transition in the future.
* High\-visibility role with direct exposure to leadership and influence over major cloud platform initiatives.
* Opportunity to shape the way a growing cloud platform scales across enterprise and education customers globally.
* Significant ownership across customer rollouts, migrations, product roadmaps, releases, and technical program delivery.
* Close collaboration with talented engineering, services, customer success, product, and leadership teams.
* Exposure to modern cloud and AI technologies and large\-scale platform initiatives.
* Opportunity to influence engineering processes, delivery practices, product readiness, and customer deployment strategies.
* Strong professional growth opportunities in technical program management, cloud platforms, and product operations.
* Competitive salary aligned with experience, skills, and market standards.
* Healthcare and other employee benefits, subject to the applicable employment package.
* Flexible working environment designed to support productivity and effective collaboration.

You will partner with sales, bid management, and delivery teams to translate client pain points into outcome\-driven solutions — architecting AIOps and observability landscapes, embedding Agentic AI into IT operations, and owning the technical solution from RFP response through to delivery handover. At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators who are focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 


  


 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 


  


 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies that rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 


  


 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals and we have fun celebrating
 
 our wins.
 


  


 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and be your best self!
 



 At Anaplan these words come to life by making employees feel empowered and inspired.
   

 Building a strong culture around company values is an ongoing journey that will continue to be the core of our existence.
 


  


 We want you to think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! Anaplan is looking for a tenacious
 **SOLUTION ARCHITECT** 
  to join 
 **PROFESSIONAL SERVICES** 
 in
 **INDIA.** 
 This is a stellar opportunity to get involved in a highly visible, large scale SaaS cloud company. This role is an immediate full\-time position. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and seek unique problems that no one else is solving, keep reading. 
 


  


**Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like**



  


**Insight on your impact** 



  


 We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi\-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.
 


  


**What you'll be doing:** 



  


 As an Anaplan Solution architect, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:
 


  

  
* Understand, review and gather client requirements per Anaplan defined scoping \& analysis
  
* Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi\-dimensional models
  
* Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
  
* Serve as the architectural SME for large\-scale connected planning solutions
  
* Exemplify The Anaplan Way
  
* Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Business Partner and team
  
* Develop Anaplan model documentation
  
* Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  
* Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment
  


  


**Your qualifications, your influence** 



  


*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills* 



  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  
* 4\+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions or 4\+ years experience in Data and Analytics
  
* 4\+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning \& Analysis or Sales Performance Management
  
* Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  
* Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  
* Superb written and oral communication skills
  
* Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  
* Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  
* Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)
  
* Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results\-oriented, motivated, self\-starter
  
* Coaching mentality
  
* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll\-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  


  


  
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion** 

**and Belonging** 



  


 Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 


  


 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
 


  


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 



  


 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 


  


 Anaplan does not:
 


  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible, and then followed up via written communication.
  


  


 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

8c01d1a0.title: Vice President - ServiceNow Architect
8c01d1a0.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview**
----------------


The ServiceNow Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and continuous evolution of the organization's ServiceNow platform. This role owns the end\-to\-end architectural vision for ServiceNow — spanning platform configuration, enterprise integrations, workflow automation, and the adoption of ServiceNow's AI and intelligence capabilities — ensuring the platform delivers measurable value across the business.


The ServiceNow Architect serves as the primary technical authority for the platform and works in close partnership with enterprise architecture, IT operations, business process owners, and product teams to transform ServiceNow from an ITSM tool into a strategic enterprise workflow automation hub. This individual operates at the intersection of technical depth and business strategy, shaping how work gets done across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Platform Architecture \& Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Own the ServiceNow platform architecture, including instance strategy (production, sub\-production), domain separation considerations, upgrade planning, and long\-term roadmap
* Establish and enforce platform governance standards: development practices, scoped application design, naming conventions, update set management, and code review processes
* Define the ServiceNow data model strategy, including CMDB architecture, CI relationships, and data integrity governance in alignment with ITIL and business requirements
* Lead architecture reviews for all significant ServiceNow development efforts, providing design authority sign\-off and ensuring alignment with platform best practices
* Maintain architectural documentation including reference architectures, design decision records, and platform topology diagrams

**Enterprise Integration Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and own the integration architecture connecting ServiceNow to the broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including ERP, ITSM, HR systems, monitoring platforms, identity providers, and cloud services
* Architect integrations using ServiceNow's native capabilities — IntegrationHub, Flow Designer spokes, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Event Management — as well as third\-party iPaaS platforms where applicable
* Define integration patterns and standards for inbound/outbound data exchange, ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability at enterprise scale
* Lead integration efforts with key enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint), Azure, Active Directory/Entra ID, monitoring and observability tools, and HR platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors)
* Establish and govern the ServiceNow CMDB as the authoritative source of truth for enterprise configuration data, including discovery tooling, reconciliation rules, and CSDM alignment
* Partner with security and IAM teams to architect identity federation, SSO (SAML/OIDC), and role\-based access control across the platform

**Workflow Automation**
-----------------------

* Lead the architectural strategy for enterprise workflow automation on the ServiceNow platform, spanning IT, HR, Legal, Finance, Facilities, and other business domains.
* Design scalable, reusable automation frameworks using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, and Scripted REST APIs.
* Architect end\-to\-end process automation for key workflows including incident management, change management, employee onboarding/offboarding, procurement, and request fulfillment.
* Define standards for automation governance: approval workflows, SLA frameworks, notification architecture, and audit trail design.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the enterprise by partnering with process owners and analyzing ticket and workflow data.
* Champion low\-code/no\-code automation patterns to enable business teams to build within governed guardrails, reducing reliance on centralized IT development

**ServiceNow AI \& Intelligence Capabilities:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Drive the adoption and architectural strategy for ServiceNow's AI and intelligence portfolio, including:


	+ **Now Assist (Generative AI):** Virtual agent augmentation, case summarization, resolution note generation, and AI\-assisted search across ITSM and non\-ITSM workflows.
	+ **Predictive Intelligence:** ML\-based classification, categorization, and routing of incidents, cases, and requests.
	+ **AI Search:** Unified enterprise search architecture leveraging ServiceNow's semantic search capabilities.
	+ **Process Optimization:** Identifying bottleneck and deviation patterns in workflows using ServiceNow's process mining capabilities.
	+ **Virtual Agent:** Conversational interface design and NLU topic architecture integrated with enterprise channels (Microsoft Teams, web portal).
* Assess organizational AI readiness, including data quality, CMDB health, and historical record hygiene as prerequisites for effective AI model performance
* Define governance and ethical use standards for AI\-driven automation and decision support within ServiceNow
* Stay current with ServiceNow's AI roadmap and evaluate new capabilities for applicability within the enterprise context

**Product \& Module Ownership**
-------------------------------

* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow product lines as adopted by the organization, which may include:


	+ IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM)
	+ HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Legal Service Delivery, Workplace Service Delivery
	+ Security Operations (SecOps), GRC / Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
	+ Customer Service Management (CSM), App Engine / Creator Workflows
* Evaluate new ServiceNow modules for strategic fit, total cost of ownership, and integration complexity before platform adoption decisions are made
* Manage the platform upgrade lifecycle, including scoped impact analysis, regression testing strategy, and stakeholder communication

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on ServiceNow capabilities, investment priorities, and platform roadmap
* Partner with process owners and product managers to translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions
* Mentor ServiceNow developers, administrators, and business analysts — establishing technical standards and elevating team capability
* Represent ServiceNow architecture in enterprise architecture governance forums and technology review boards
* Manage the relationship with ServiceNow account teams, technical success managers, and implementation partners to maximize platform value

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in a senior architecture or technical lead role focused on ServiceNow
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across core ServiceNow platform capabilities:


	+ **Platform:** Instance architecture, Application Engine, Scoped Apps, CMDB, CSDM, Update Sets, ATF
	+ **Automation:** Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, Scheduled Jobs, Event Management
	+ **Integration:** REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, LDAP/SSO, Azure/AWS connectors, iPaaS patterns
	+ **ITSM/ITOM/ITAM:** Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Discovery, Service Mapping, HAM/SAM
	+ **Portal \& UX:** Service Portal, Now Experience (UI Builder), Employee Center
