1a64bc75.title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
1a64bc75.description:
**Company:** 
 Free Stand Sampling Solutions Pvt. Ltd. ("FreeStand") 
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi \& Mumbai, close to the founding team and our enterprise clients. 
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Early/founding hire · High ownership 
 



**Reports to:** 
 \[Founder / CBO]
 



  





**Read this before you apply** 




  





 Most "customer success" jobs are relationship\-management jobs: QBRs, check\-ins, a calendar full of cadence. This is not that.This is a
 **builder's seat.** 
 You'll be measured on getting blue\-chip FMCG brands
 *live, instrumented and expanding* 
   not on meeting frequency. You'll configure our internal tooling yourself, build the demo a brand evaluates, wire up their dashboards, write the SQL, and clear the legal and operational steps between a signed contract and a working campaign. When our defaults don't fit a brand's ask, you won't escalate and wait, you'll design the workaround.We're upfront about this because the people who thrive here read that and get
 *excited* 
 , not deterred. If you want a polished account\-management role with a comfortable cadence, this isn't it. If you want to own outcomes in ambiguity, get your hands into the tooling and the data, and
 *define a function* 
 rather than inherit one, keep reading.
 



  





**About FreeStand** 




 FreeStand is a
 **digital sampling and customer\-engagement platform for FMCG brands.** 
 Founded in 2019 and built in Delhi, we help brands plan, execute, monitor and audit product\-sampling campaigns digitally \- putting the right sample in the right consumer's hands at the right moment, and turning every sample into a measurable customer\-engagement opportunity. We run campaigns for brands across India, managed from our Delhi base.
 



 A few things worth knowing about who you'd be joining:
 


* **We work with the biggest names in FMCG.** 
 FreeStand is the sampling partner of choice for 40\+ brands, including
 **L'Oréal (CeraVe), HUL, Nestlé, Nivea, Reckitt, Emami, Mars Petcare, Cipla (Nicotex) and Piramal (Little's).**
* **Our campaigns operate at real scale.** 
 Individual launches have reached
 **10M\+ consumers** 
 (e.g. L'Oréal CeraVe's India launch and Nivea's first\-party\-data campaign), with customer\-satisfaction scores above 95% on programmes like Piramal Little's.
* **We're backed and recognised.** 
 FreeStand is backed by
 **Venture Catalysts, SucSEED Indovation and Nocking Point Advisors** 
 across multiple seed rounds, and has been recognised by the
 **Google for Startups Accelerator (Women Founders cohort)** 
 ,
 **IIM Calcutta Innovation Park** 
 and
 **I\-Venture @ ISB** 
 .
* **We're founder\-led and lean.** 
 You will work directly with the founders, your decisions will be visible every single day, and your wins will be felt immediately.



  





 Here's the part most candidates miss:
 **signing a blue\-chip brand is the start, not the finish.** 
 The gap between a signed contract and a live, instrumented, expanding campaign is exactly where enterprise deals are won or lost.
 *That gap is what this role owns.* 
 When a brand like L'Oréal or HUL trusts FreeStand, you are the person who turns that trust into a working, measurable campaign and into the next one.
 



  





**The role** 




 You own what happens after a brand signs, and part of what happens just before. You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring our internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live. When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
 



 This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands
 *live, instrumented, and expanding,* 
 not on meeting cadence.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result accounts that stay live and grow
 *because they're properly instrumented* 
 . Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function. The playbook you build becomes the product that the next deployment runs on.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* **4–7 years** 
 in solutions engineering, implementation/onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech, or adtech company.
* **Hands\-on data fluency:** 
 You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* **Ownership in ambiguity:** 
 You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* **Enterprise stakeholder management:** 
 You've sat across from brand/marketing, procurement and legal, ideally in or around FMCG/CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu) and moved them.
* **Communication:** 
 Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.Bonus
* Exposure to FMCG / CPG brand\-marketing teams or agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Light scripting (Python / JS), API / integration comfort, or hands\-on use of AI / LLM tooling.
* Experience at a company with a forward\-deployed or solutions\-led delivery model.



  





**Your first year** 




 This role has a clear arc \- from shipping your first brand to owning the function.
 


* **Months 0 to 3 \- Your first deployment.** 
 Take one signed brand from contract to live, instrumented campaign, end\-to\-end. Learn our tooling, our brands and our defaults cold. By the end, you've shipped something real.
* **Months 3 to 6 \- Your own book.** 
 Run multiple enterprise deployments independently. Every account lives, dashboarded and adopted without hand\-holding. Time\-to\-live trending down as you build repeatable patterns.
* **Months 6 to 12 \- Define the function.** 
 Turn your patterns into SOPs and tooling specs with Product, set the standard for how FreeStand deploys enterprise brands and lay the groundwork for the team you'll eventually lead.



 You won't be left to sink: direct access to the founders, real authority to unblock, and clear targets. What you won't get is vagueness about what success means, and that's by design.
 



  





**How we'll measure success (first 6–12 months)** 




 The metric we obsess over first:
 **time from contract signed to first live campaign.** 
 Everything else compounds from there:
 


* **Activation:** 
 dashboards and analytics delivered and adopted, per account.
* **Retention:** 
 gross retention and health of your book of enterprise accounts.
* **Expansion:** 
 growth influenced within existing accounts.
* **Product impact:** 
 feedback converted into shipped tooling.



  





 Clear ownership, clear outcomes. This is what makes the role serious and what makes the trajectory below real when you deliver.
 



  





**Why this role \- and where it goes** 




 You'll join early, with high ownership, at an AI\-native company working with blue\-chip consumer brands. You won't just operate a process \- you'll
 **define this function and help build the tooling that powers it.** 




 That's also the path forward. The person who builds FreeStand's forward\-deployed delivery motion from the ground up and proves it converts signed brands into live, expanding accounts is first in line to lead this function as it grows: more accounts, a team to build, and the same playbook stood up as FreeStand scales beyond India. This is a genuine, named prospect of the role, not a vague promise.
 



  





**Compensation** 




 Competitive fixed salary, outcome\-linked variable, and meaningful ESOPs.
 



 ₹15L fixed \+ ₹5L variable \+ ESOPs
 



  





**Selection process** 




 We're selective about this one, on purpose.
 


1. Fill out the application form with short notes.
2. A solutioning working session: we'll put a real FreeStand brand scenario in front of you and build the campaign configuration together.
3. A short analytics task shows us how you'd stand up a dashboard that a brand would actually use.
4. Final conversation with the entire team.



  





 If owning outcomes in ambiguity excites you and building the function does too, apply. We're moving fast.
 



 FreeStand is a women\-led, equal\-opportunity workplace. Made with care in Delhi.

2a777778.title: Program Manager
2a777778.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Title

**Program Manager**

Department

Engineering

Reports To

Engineering Manager

Direct Reports

* Nil standing direct reports; a graduate engineer or program coordinator may be assigned.
* Matrix leadership of cross\-functional program teams drawn from Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial.

Position Overview

The Program Manager is accountable for the delivery of Microair Avionics' OEM customer programs and internal development projects, several running concurrently at different stages of maturity.

Based at Microair's Indore facility and working across the company's Australian, US, Irish and Indian operations, the role converts customer commitments into achievable plans, keeps those plans honest as they meet reality, and removes whatever stands between the delivery team and the outcome.

Authority is held over program scope, schedule baseline, budget and risk disposition within the approved contract, and the position is the delegated voice of Microair to the customer on program matters.

Leadership is exercised through influence rather than line authority: the team creates the value, and the Program Manager's job is to enable it.

Key Responsibilities1\. Program Ownership

Hold end\-to\-end accountability for multiple concurrent OEM delivery programs and development projects, from contract award through certification to entry into service and closeout.

2\. Scope Translation \& Planning

Dissect the customer statement of work into a detailed, resourced and achievable plan — work breakdown, schedule, milestones and dependencies — expressed so the delivery team and the customer work from the same picture.

3\. Team Enablement

Operate on the basis that the team creates customer and company value, not the manager. Clear roadblocks, protect focus, and secure the resources and decisions the team is waiting on, including those held in another time zone.

4\. Influence Without Authority

Secure commitment, priority and follow\-through from peers and their teams across Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial — and across the Indian, Australian, Irish and US sites — without relying on positional authority.

5\. Customer Engagement

Act as the principal customer\-facing contact for assigned programs and represent Microair credibly at OEM design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and program gates, contributing to the technical discussion rather than deferring it.

6\. Risk \& Opportunity Management

Run living risk and opportunity registers on every program, on the basis that unmanaged risk is the most likely cause of schedule slip. Own mitigations to closure and pursue opportunities with equal discipline.

7\. Schedule, Cost \& Revenue

Own program schedule, cost and revenue performance. Maintain credible forecasts, manage milestone claims and revenue timing, and escalate early and with options.

8\. Change \& Variation Control

Identify scope change as it emerges, assess the schedule and cost impact, and agree variations with the customer before the work is quietly absorbed.

9\. Value Realisation

Define how the value created by each program is measured, and test that against what the customer expects and pays for, so any gap surfaces while there is still time to act.

Skills \& ExperienceEducation

* Bachelor degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in engineering or a related technical discipline — essential.
* Formal program or project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) — desirable.
* A substantial delivery track record is accepted in lieu of formal qualifications.

Experience

* Minimum 8 years in engineering or technical delivery, including 4 years managing programs in their own right — essential.
* Demonstrated ownership of several concurrent customer programs and development projects — essential.
* Met schedule, cost and revenue commitments on fixed\-price and milestone\-based contracts — essential.
* Managed distributed teams and customers across Indian, Australian, European and US time zones — essential.
* Fluent professional English; willing to travel internationally to customer and Microair sites — essential.
* Aerospace or avionics background — desirable; equivalent experience in another regulated safety\-critical domain (defence electronics, automotive functional safety, medical devices, rail) is accepted.
* Exposure to STC and TSO/ETSO certification schedules — desirable.

System Knowledge

* Scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera or equivalent) and Microsoft 365 to intermediate Excel — essential.
* Yogi for requirements and Xray for verification traceability, sufficient to read program status from the tools rather than from status meetings — desirable.
* Dynamics 365 Business Central for cost, purchasing and material visibility — desirable.
* Aircraft systems and avionics architecture sufficient to hold a technical conversation with an OEM; working awareness of ARP4754B, ARP4761A, DO\-160, DO\-178C and DO\-254 — valued.

Pay: ₹726,115\.68 \- ₹1,226,025\.36 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

1a9c1088.title: Sr. Program Manager, Brand Protections
1a9c1088.description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
   

  

 The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
   

  

**Role**
 We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
* Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
* This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5\+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.


 This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

Maintain reporting cadence and ensure exceptions are clearly flagged with mitigation and decision requests.
* Operating model and organisational effectiveness : Review and shape organisational structure improvements, identify capability/skills gaps, and drive actions to close those gaps. Improve ways of working, clarify accountabilities, and streamline execution across functions.
* Cross\-team coordination and blocker removal : Connect teams working on related initiatives, manage interdependencies, and proactively remove delivery constraints. Escalate issues early and drive resolution or sponsor decisions within agreed timeframes.
* Stakeholder management and governance hygiene : Run decision\-led governance forums (ExCo/SteerCo/working groups), ensuring agendas and papers are issued in advance and minutes/actions are distributed promptly. Maintain stakeholder distribution lists and coordinate consistent communications.
* Executive communications and reputation management : Act as a communications arm for the leadership team, shaping and delivering an integrated communications approach aligned to GCIO strategies. Coordinate content for internal and external forums to strengthen business reputation and positioning.
* Leadership engagement, events and community building : Plan and deliver leadership visits, offsites, all\-hands and townhalls (including content curation), and leadership exchange meetings. Ensure communications and events land well with employees and drive clarity, engagement and alignment.
* People agenda and culture stewardship : Contribute to and drive the people agenda for the Global Tech Centres, with a focus on culture, employee wellbeing and engagement. Serve as a trusted liaison between staff, senior leaders and executives.
* DEI sponsorship and representation : Act as a working DEI sponsor, representing the Head of HTI in DEI working groups/CWGs. Provide a sounding board for DEI initiatives and help convert ideas into practical, measurable actions.
* Executive operations and meeting effectiveness : Prepare materials for workshops, conferences, meetings and offsites, including drafting presentations and managing document flow. Ensure leadership time is used effectively through crisp briefs, clear decisions and disciplined follow\-through.
* Financial oversight and operational management : Track portfolio costs against budget, maintain forecast accuracy, and manage workloads efficiently across self/team. Ensure artefacts are stored appropriately and retrievable quickly to support audit and governance needs.
* Risk, compliance and audit readiness : Uphold HSBC internal control standards, drive closure of audit points and issues raised by regulators, and manage compliance risk in partnership with relevant compliance stakeholders. Ensure early engagement on new initiatives and maintain appropriate evidence and records.
* Tech–Ops–Business alignment leadership : Lead collaboration across Technology, Operations and Business to align on shared outcomes (delivery, resilience, controls and people). Build accountability by ensuring Tier\-1 initiatives have named sponsors, owners and success metrics.


**In This Role, You Will**
* Post\-graduate degree in management or technology from a reputed university is desirable. Evidence of continuous learning in programme leadership, communications, governance or transformation is beneficial.
* Proven experience in similar leadership roles : Demonstrable success in Chief of Staff / strategic delivery / transformation programme roles, ideally within large, complex organisations. Track record should be measurable and referenceable, showing tangible outcomes delivered.
* Strong executive stakeholder management : Extensive experience engaging CxO\-level and senior leadership stakeholders, building confidence through clarity, predictability and disciplined follow\-through. Comfortable influencing without direct authority across multiple sponsors and priorities.
* Programme and portfolio management capability : Strong hands\-on experience with portfolio planning, milestone management, RAID and dependency mapping, and structured governance routines. Able to run decision\-led SteerCos/ExCos and sustain a high\-quality reporting cadence.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and drive outcomes : Evidence of success in roles with shifting priorities and unclear problem statements, bringing analytical rigour and structure. Able to frame problems, evaluate options, and drive practical solutions at pace.
* High\-impact communication and executive writing : Excellent communication skills across written, verbal and presentation formats, including creation of management packs, decks and briefings for very senior audiences. Able to simplify complex topics and make decisions easier.
* Networking and cross\-functional coordination : Strong experience coordinating across organisational functions, geographies and time zones, connecting teams working on similar initiatives. Skilled at aligning diverse perspectives towards shared outcomes.
* Governance, controls and audit discipline : Strong understanding of governance artefacts, audit requirements and internal control standards, with proven ability to close control gaps. Able to maintain audit\-ready documentation, evidence and timely remediation tracking.
* Operational effectiveness and delivery rhythm : Able to manage workload effectively, prioritise competing demands, and escalate early with clear options and recommendations. Strong attention to detail with reliable follow\-through on actions and commitments.
* Financial and commercial awareness : Experience tracking programme spend, managing budgets and forecasts, and maintaining financial discipline within approved tolerances. Comfortable linking spend to outcomes and benefits where quantification is challenging.
* Leadership capabilities aligned to HSBC expectations : Demonstrates the ability to navigate (align direction), aspire (raise standards), drive (deliver stretching goals), mobilise (engage stakeholders), and sustain (protect values, reputation and long\-term outcomes).
* People, culture and engagement orientation : Experience supporting people agenda initiatives (engagement, wellbeing, culture), and running leadership engagement events that improve clarity and connection. Able to foster accountability while maintaining a supportive team environment.

1a565d10.title: Databricks Data Science Solution Architect
1a565d10.description:
**Position Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Databricks Data Science Solution Architect** 
 to provide in\-region technical leadership and hands\-on development support to an established APAC Data Science team.
 



 This role is focused specifically on the
 **design, development, deployment, and operationalization of data science and machine learning solutions within Databricks** 
 . The successful candidate will have strong Python development experience and a demonstrated background building production data science solutions using Databricks capabilities such as
 **Apps, Jobs, Pipelines, model serving Endpoints, MLflow, and related platform services** 
 .
 



 This is
 **not primarily a data engineering role** 
 . While data preparation and data management are components of the position, the primary responsibility is to guide data scientists on how to architect, build, deploy, and support production\-ready data science applications and machine learning models on Databricks.
 



 The individual will work closely with the APAC Data Science team, ModelOps platform teams, data engineers, and business stakeholders to establish effective development patterns and ensure data science solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and production\-ready.
 



**Principal Duties and Responsibilities** 




**1\. Data Science Solution Design and Architecture** 



* Provide architectural leadership for data science, machine learning, AI, and advanced analytics solutions developed within Databricks.
* Guide data scientists in translating analytical concepts and models into scalable, production\-ready Databricks solutions.
* Design solution architectures incorporating Databricks
 **Apps, Jobs, Pipelines, model serving Endpoints, MLflow, Unity Catalog, and related platform capabilities** 
 .
* Establish reusable design patterns and development standards for deploying Python\-based data science solutions.
* Review existing data science solutions and recommend improvements to architecture, scalability, maintainability, and operational supportability.



**2\. Python Data Science Development** 



* Develop and review production\-quality
 **Python code** 
 supporting machine learning, predictive analytics, statistical modeling, and data science applications.
* Work directly with data scientists to convert notebooks, prototypes, and analytical models into maintainable production applications.
* Establish Python development standards, project structures, reusable libraries, testing practices, dependency management, and deployment patterns.
* Troubleshoot Python\-based data science applications and provide technical guidance on performance, reliability, and maintainability.



**3\. Databricks Application and Workload Development** 




 Design, develop, and support data science solutions using Databricks capabilities including:
 


* **Databricks Apps**
* **Databricks Jobs and Workflows**
* **Databricks Pipelines**
* **Model Serving Endpoints**
* **MLflow**
* **Unity Catalog**
* **Databricks Asset Bundles**
* Notebooks and Python development environments
* Databricks compute and cluster environments



 Guide the team in selecting the appropriate Databricks components based on application requirements and deployment objectives.
 



**4\. Machine Learning Model Deployment and ModelOps** 



* Guide data scientists through the complete model lifecycle from experimentation and development through production deployment and ongoing support.
* Establish best practices for:
* Model packaging
* Model versioning
* Experiment tracking
* Model registration
* Automated testing
* Deployment
* Model serving
* Monitoring
* Retraining
* Use MLflow and Databricks capabilities to promote reproducible and maintainable machine learning development.
* Support the deployment of Python\-based models as Databricks applications, scheduled jobs, pipelines, APIs, and serving endpoints.



**5\. Technical Leadership and Mentorship** 



* Serve as a senior technical advisor to the APAC Data Science team.
* Conduct solution design reviews and provide hands\-on guidance throughout development.
* Mentor data scientists in software engineering and production development practices.
* Help data scientists transition experimental models and notebooks into production\-ready solutions.
* Establish reference implementations, coding standards, reusable patterns, and technical documentation.
* Lead technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions on Databricks data science development.



**6\. Solution Integration** 



* Design integrations between Databricks data science solutions and enterprise systems, applications, APIs, databases, and downstream consumers.
* Support development of APIs and service\-based interfaces for exposing model outputs and analytical functionality.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams where data pipelines or transformations are required to support data science solutions.
* Ensure appropriate use of enterprise authentication, authorization, data access, and security patterns.



**7\. Performance, Scalability, and Production Support** 



* Optimize Python and Databricks workloads for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost.
* Troubleshoot production issues involving Databricks applications, jobs, pipelines, models, and endpoints.
* Establish monitoring, logging, observability, and error\-handling practices for production data science solutions.
* Recommend appropriate Databricks compute configurations based on data science workloads and application requirements.



**8\. Collaboration** 




 Partner closely with:
 


* APAC Data Science teams
* ModelOps and AI Enablement teams
* Platform Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Application Development teams
* Business stakeholders
* Information Security and Data Governance teams



 Translate analytical and business requirements into practical technical designs and production implementations.
 



  





**Job Specifications** 




**Education and Experience** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in software development, data science, machine learning engineering, solution architecture, or related technical roles.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and developing
 **data science or machine learning solutions within Databricks** 
 .
* Strong hands\-on
 **Python development experience** 
 supporting production data science or machine learning solutions.
* Demonstrated experience moving data science models from experimentation or notebooks into production environments.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.



  





**Preferred** 



* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
* Databricks certification.
* Experience supporting enterprise Data Science or Machine Learning teams.
* Experience within insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.



  





**Required Skills and Abilities** 



* Advanced
 **Python development** 
 skills with experience developing production\-quality data science and machine learning solutions.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying data science solutions within
 **Databricks** 
 .
* Experience with Databricks capabilities such as:
* Apps
* Jobs / Workflows
* Pipelines
* Model Serving Endpoints
* MLflow
* Unity Catalog
* Databricks Asset Bundles
* Strong understanding of machine learning and data science development workflows.
* Experience deploying predictive models and analytical applications into production.
* Experience converting notebooks and experimental models into maintainable production solutions.
* Understanding of MLOps / ModelOps principles including:
* Experiment tracking
* Model registration
* Version control
* Automated testing
* CI/CD
* Deployment
* Monitoring
* Model retraining
* Experience with Git and modern software development lifecycle practices.
* Experience developing or integrating APIs and application services.
* Ability to troubleshoot Python, Databricks, and machine learning application issues.
* Strong understanding of software engineering principles including modular development, testing, documentation, and source control.
* Ability to mentor and guide experienced data scientists on production development practices.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical architecture and development concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with
 **Posit Workbench and Posit Connect** 
 .
* Experience with R in addition to Python.
* Experience with Spark and PySpark.
* Experience with REST APIs and microservice architectures.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
* Experience with model monitoring and observability.
* Knowledge of Generative AI or LLM\-based application development within Databricks.
* Experience developing interactive analytical or data science applications.
* Knowledge of enterprise security, governance, and data access controls.
* Experience with insurance, actuarial, risk, or financial\-services data science applications.



  





**Key Candidate Profile** 




 The strongest candidate will be someone who has
 **actually built data science and machine learning solutions in Databricks using Python** 
 , rather than someone whose Databricks experience is primarily focused on data engineering.
 



 We are specifically seeking candidates who can demonstrate experience taking a Python\-based data science model or application and implementing it as a production Databricks solution using capabilities such as
 **Databricks Apps, Jobs, Pipelines, MLflow, and model serving Endpoints** 
 .
 



 The individual must also be comfortable acting as a technical leader and mentor to an existing team of data scientists, helping them determine
 **how their solutions should be designed and developed within Databricks** 
 .

088fc25b.title: Solution Engineer (Post Sales)
088fc25b.description:
**Hevo Data** 




**Solution Engineer (Post\-sales)** 




**About Hevo** 




 DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.
 



 We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**What You Will Not Be Doing** 




 This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
 



**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.

The Architect will work closely with clients, Professional Services, R\&D, and partner teams to ensure successful implementation, integration, and deployment of SCM GOLD solutions across large\-scale retail environments. This role is critical for high\-visibility programs and will provide architectural leadership from solution design through implementation, UAT, and production cutover.

* Translate complex retail supply chain requirements into scalable functional and technical solution designs.
* Define system architecture, integration frameworks, and configuration strategy across SCM GOLD modules.
* Guide design decisions across forecasting, replenishment, inventory optimization, and supply chain planning capabilities.

* Lead technical and functional discussions with client executives, program leaders, and technical teams.
* Act as the primary architecture authority during design workshops, solution reviews, and executive checkpoints.

* Support client change management and adoption of SCM GOLD capabilities.

* Collaborate with Professional Services, Partner Delivery teams, and Implementation Leads to ensure solution integrity throughout the program lifecycle.
* Provide oversight during key delivery phases including design validation, system build, UAT readiness, and production cutover.
* Support risk mitigation and architectural governance for complex implementations.


**Technical Skills:**
* Hands\-on experience in:
+ Solid understanding of System Design \& Architecture and Integration.
+ Solid understanding of Java (core Java).
+ Solid understanding of REST APIs.
+ Solid understanding of database concepts (preferably Oracle), SQL, and PL/SQL.
+ Solid understanding of Shell scripting.
+ Fair understanding of JavaScript/HTML/CSS\-based applications implementation.
+ Basic understanding of Vue/React\-based applications implementation.


**Other Experience:**
* 10\+ years of experience in retail supply chain technology implementations.
* Deep expertise in SymphonyAI SCM GOLD platform (technical and functional) is a plus but not essential.

Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI has grown to today serve 2000\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 2,500 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

 You define
 **end\-to\-end architecture for Incedo’s AI\-powered enterprise products** 
 — applications, APIs, data, security and infrastructure — and you make it hold up across cloud, scale and audit.

 contracts, versioning and integration patterns.

 on Azure, AWS or GCP, with containerisation and Kubernetes in production.

 security by design, secrets management, supply chain and CI/CD pipelines.

 performance, availability, observability, cost and compliance.

d734cf2d.title: Technical Program Manager
d734cf2d.description:
**Technical Program Manager** 




**Delivery • Client Coordination • Requirement Management** 




**Company:** 
 Allsec AI
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai
 



**Website:** 
 www.allsec.ai
 



**Engagement Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| Early\-Stage Start\-up
 







  





**About Allsec AI**




 Allsec AI is an AI\-native, digital\-first, omni\-channel CX managed services company. We help enterprises unlock scalable, efficient, and real\-time customer experience operations through agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and automation. We are redefining outsourcing by delivering packaged, outcome\-led services that eliminate traditional contact centre inefficiencies.
 



  





**About This Role**




 As Technical Program Manager, you will sit at the intersection of client delivery, engineering execution, and stakeholder communication. You will take client inputs and translate them into structured, actionable briefs for the engineering team. You will manage delivery timelines, track progress, and ensure nothing falls through the gap between a conversation and an execution.
 



 You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the Principal Engineer on a day\-to\-day basis.
 



 This is not a coordination role. It is an ownership role. If something is unclear, you clarify it. If something is at risk, you flag it. If something is falling behind, you fix it or escalate it, before anyone has to ask.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




***Requirement \& Client Management***



* Own the end\-to\-end process of translating client inputs into structured, actionable requirements for the engineering team
* Run or support requirement gathering conversations with clients — ask the right questions, document precisely, and eliminate ambiguity before it reaches engineering
* Maintain a living requirements log that serves as the single source of truth for the tech team, sales team, and leadership
* Manage client communication on delivery timelines, progress, and changes — proactively, not reactively
* Coordinate with clients on feedback, UAT, and sign\-off for deliverables



***Engineering Coordination***



* Work directly with the Principal Engineer to prioritise, scope, and sequence work across active projects
* Translate business and client requirements into engineering\-digestible briefs — clear problem statements with context, constraints, and acceptance criteria
* Track engineering progress against commitments and flag risks early — before deadlines are missed
* Own the feedback loop between engineering output and client expectations
* Be the gatekeeper for new requests — filter, prioritise, and protect the tech team from unnecessary context\-switching



***Stakeholder Management***



* Manage competing inputs from sales, marketing, and leadership — consolidate, prioritise, and push back where necessary
* Run structured stand\-ups or equivalent touchpoints to maintain team alignment
* Maintain visibility trackers that give leadership a clear picture of what is in progress, what is at risk, and what is done
* Represent delivery status accurately — not optimistically



***Process \& Documentation***



* Build and maintain the operational infrastructure of the delivery function — templates, trackers, communication formats, and handoff protocols
* Document decisions, not just outcomes — there must always be a written record of why something was built a certain way
* Identify process gaps and address them before they become delivery problems



  





**Requirements**




***Must Have***



* 2\+ years of experience in a TPM, delivery management, business analyst, or program coordination role
* Demonstrated experience working between technical and non\-technical stakeholders — you can speak engineering without being an engineer, and you can speak business without losing the technical thread
* Strong written communication — your requirement documents, client updates, and internal briefs must be clear, precise, and usable without editing. This will be tested.
* At least some direct client or stakeholder exposure — you have been in the room, taken notes, and followed up
* Comfort with ambiguity and early\-stage environments — there is no established playbook here; you will build it
* Background in engineering (BTech/BE in CS, IT, or ECE preferred) or equivalent technical literacy gained through experience



***Strong Plus***



* Experience at a startup, consulting firm, or managed services company — not just large IT services
* Familiarity with AI, voice technology, or CX platforms — you don’t need to be technical, but you need to be curious enough to understand what the team is building
* Hands\-on experience with project or delivery tools — Jira, Asana, Notion, Confluence, or similar
* Experience writing requirement documents, BRDs, or functional specs that engineers have actually used



  





**What This Is Not**




 This is not a role for someone who needs a fully defined scope, a large team around them, or a manager to tell them what to do next. The boundaries of this role will expand as the company grows — and the person in this seat is expected to grow with them.
 



 If you are looking for a stable, well\-defined program management position at a large organisation, this is not that.
 



  





**Why Join Allsec AI**



* Direct access to the CEO and a front\-row seat to building an AI\-native company from its earliest stage
* You will understand the full lifecycle of AI product delivery — from client requirement to live deployment — faster than you would anywhere else
* Real ownership from day one — what you build here will be used by enterprise clients and will directly shape how the company operates
* Clear growth path: as the company scales, this role grows into leading the full delivery and client success function
* Competitive compensation and equity consideration for the right candidate



  





**Contact**




 If you think this role excites you, please send your resume to
 **careers@allsec.ai** 
 or
 **hr@allsec.ai** 
 .

The role involves managing end\-to\-end research projects, analysing and interpreting data, and presenting findings to support strategic decision\-making, business growth, and product or market development.
 



 The role will also support clients in evaluating and making informed decisions regarding
 **entry into and expansion within the Indian market** 
 , including assistance with market assessment, organisational setup, and implementation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Communicate directly with clients, as required, to understand, clarify, and document their business objectives and research requirements.
* Develop research and analysis plans and obtain client alignment and sign\-off.
* Conduct in\-depth primary research through relevant methodologies, including interviews, surveys, focus groups, and stakeholder interactions.
* Conduct comprehensive research and data analysis using an effective combination of primary and secondary sources.
* Design or assist in the development of questionnaires, discussion guides, and moderator guides to ensure relevant data is collected.
* Analyse qualitative and quantitative data to identify meaningful trends, insights, opportunities, and risks.
* Translate research findings into actionable recommendations that add value to the client's business.
* Prepare detailed reports and other research deliverables containing clear findings and recommendations.
* Develop and deliver client presentations, respond to queries, and effectively communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support clients in making informed decisions regarding market entry and business opportunities in India.
* Assist clients with organisational setup and implementation activities in India, where required.
* Travel across cities for primary research, stakeholder interactions, and collection of relevant market data.
* Manage multiple research projects simultaneously while ensuring quality, accuracy, and timely delivery.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
 **Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics, or a related field** 
 .
* **5–8 years of relevant experience** 
 in market research, consumer insights, business intelligence, strategy consulting, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of primary and secondary research methodologies.
* Experience in designing surveys, questionnaires, discussion guides, and conducting or supporting focus groups and interviews.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex qualitative and quantitative data.
* Ability to derive meaningful insights and translate research findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Knowledge or experience in market assessment, competitive analysis, and
 **India market entry** 
 would be an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong report\-writing and presentation abilities.
* Strong client management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and other relevant data analysis or research tools.

1cb060f0.title: Program Manager
1cb060f0.company: Global Access to Talent from India (GATI) Foundation
1cb060f0.description:
**Organization:** 
 Global Access to Talent from India (GATI)
 



**Location:** 
 Maharashtra (Mumbai preferred; travel across the state as required)
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About GATI** 




 Global Access to Talent from India (GATI) is a mission\-driven organization working to position India as the world's most trusted source of global talent. GATI partners with governments, industry, international employers, training institutions, and ecosystem stakeholders to build sustainable global workforce pathways, strengthen international labour mobility, and create high\-quality overseas employment opportunities for Indian talent. Through strategic partnerships, policy engagement, and program implementation, GATI works to strengthen India's global workforce mobility ecosystem.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 GATI is seeking an experienced
 **Program Manager – Private Sector Engagement (Maharashtra)** 
 to lead industry partnerships and employer engagement across Maharashtra. The Program Manager will be responsible for building and managing relationships with companies, industry associations, employers, chambers of commerce, sector bodies, and ecosystem partners to expand participation in GATI's workforce mobility initiatives. The role will focus on catalyzing private sector participation, identifying strategic partnerships, supporting program implementation, and creating sustainable employer pipelines for international workforce mobility.
 



  





 This is a highly external\-facing role requiring exceptional relationship management, business development, and program execution skills. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, comfortable engaging CXOs and senior leadership, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment where stakeholder management and execution go hand in hand.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Private Sector Partnerships** 



* Build and manage strategic relationships with employers, industry associations, chambers of commerce, sector councils, and private sector organizations across Maharashtra.
* Identify and onboard companies interested in participating in international workforce mobility and global talent initiatives.
* Develop and execute engagement strategies to expand GATI's employer and industry network.
* Serve as one of the key relationship managers for key private sector partners across the state.



  





**Business Development \& Industry Engagement** 



* Identify new partnership opportunities aligned with GATI's strategic priorities.
* Conduct outreach to employers and ecosystem partners through meetings, presentations, and industry forums.
* Develop partnership proposals, concept notes, presentations, and engagement plans.
* Support the development of employer\-led workforce mobility initiatives and collaborative programs.



  





**Program Management** 



* Lead planning and execution of industry engagement programs, pilots, consultations, and partnership initiatives.
* Develop implementation plans, timelines, stakeholder engagement strategies, and monitoring frameworks.
* Ensure timely execution of deliverables while coordinating across internal teams and external partners.
* Track program progress and prepare regular updates for leadership.



  





**Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Coordinate with employers, training institutions, universities, government agencies, and international partners to deliver collaborative initiatives.
* Build consensus among multiple stakeholders and facilitate cross\-sector partnerships.
* Secure opportunities for GATI at industry events, conferences, roundtables, consultations, and networking forums.



  





**Research \& Market Intelligence** 



* Track industry trends, workforce demand, labour market developments, and employer requirements across priority sectors.
* Conduct market research to identify emerging opportunities for international talent mobility.
* Synthesize research into actionable insights to support strategic decision\-making and partner engagement.



  





**Operations \& Execution** 



* Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining high\-quality execution.
* Coordinate internal teams, consultants, and external stakeholders.
* Maintain stakeholder databases, partnership trackers, CRM systems, and program documentation.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on commitments and resolution of operational challenges.



  





**Events \& Convenings** 



* Lead planning and execution of employer roundtables, industry consultations, conferences, workshops, and delegation visits.
* Coordinate speakers, industry leaders, partners, logistics, and communications.
* Manage post\-event engagement, reporting, and action tracking.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* 5–8 years of experience in industry partnerships, corporate engagement, business development, strategic partnerships, consulting, employer engagement, or program management.
* Strong network within Maharashtra's private sector, industry associations, or employer ecosystem is highly desirable.
* Experience engaging CXOs, senior executives, and business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to build partnerships and manage complex stakeholder relationships.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Strong project management and execution capabilities with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and problem\-solving abilities.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Maharashtra.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, Commerce, or a related field.
* Experience working with industry associations, chambers of commerce, consulting firms, skilling organizations, workforce development initiatives, or international business programs.
* Strong understanding of employer engagement, talent acquisition, workforce development, or global mobility ecosystems.
* Experience preparing partnership proposals, presentations, business cases, and stakeholder communications.
* Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in Marathi and Hindi will be an advantage.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to build and shape strategic private sector partnerships that strengthen India's global workforce mobility ecosystem.
* Direct engagement with industry leaders, employers, and national and international partners.
* A high\-impact role with significant ownership, visibility, and opportunities for growth.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial work environment where innovation, execution, and collaboration are valued.
* The opportunity to contribute to transformative workforce mobility initiatives with industry at the center of implementation.

02a30152.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
02a30152.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI\-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost\-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low\-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self\-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI\-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise\-grade decision\-making.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager, reporting to a Head of TPM on the Analytics Platform team you will define product/program technical strategy. You will create long term vision for the team and associated roadmap for your areas of ownership and ensure buy in from stakeholders. You will leverage deep domain expertise and technical acumen to ensure successful delivery of large cross organization initiatives. You will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental business challenges, shape technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to develop comprehensive solutions. You will utilize your technical expertise to influence solution architecture to meet the emerging needs of the business and contribute to programs and process across organizational boundaries.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Analyze business objectives, customer needs, product adoption inhibitors and opportunities, industry trends, and based on these, in close collaboration with your stakeholders, define a long\-term strategy and roadmap for your platform and product components.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into technical systems problems that need to be prioritized solved in the current business environment.
* Define specific systems programs and create a plan of action for realizing those programs. Such programs could be around capacity planning, migration efforts, high availability, network architecture, performance optimization, reliability improvements and more.
* Use your technical understanding of Atlassian and related systems to partner with and influence engineers and architects in making progress on these problems.
* Responsible for taking a systematic approach to engineering problems. This includes: prioritizing tasks, scoping out the project, defining objectives, and making consistent progress against each of these.
* Be accountable for the success of these technical programs by managing the entire lifecycle from initiation to forecasting, budgeting, scheduling, etc.
* Manage complex dependencies and projects with a broad scope across the company


**Compensation**
 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience on software teams as Development Manager or TPM
* Strategic thinking and ability to understand business objectives to translate them into technical problems and programs.
* Technical understanding of systems involved. Willingness to develop domain expertise in the area they operate \- storage, networking, authentication, capacity management, service deployments, etc.
+ TPMs are not expected to write or read code, but are expected to understand system flows, block architectures, APIs and such.

* Experience defining and running end\-to\-end complex technical programs
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills


**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits** 
**.**
**About Atlassian**
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
   

  

 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/crh** 
**.**
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

2c0b653e.description:
We're looking for a seasoned
 **Delivery Manager – GCP Cloud** 
 who can spearhead extensive cloud transformation, migration, and modernization initiatives, overseeing complete delivery cycles through cross\-functional teams, managing key stakeholder relationships, and delivering strong business results.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Take full ownership of programme delivery spanning discovery, assessment, landing\-zone readiness, wave planning, migration execution, cutover, warranty, and transition to operations, holding overall accountability for Project/People/Account Management
* Direct multiple cross\-functional and distributed teams, handling scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive governance, while staying mindful of Data Privacy, Security, IP \& Responsible AI activities
* Assess solution architectures and migration strategies, confirming application dependency maps, migration waves, security, resilience, performance, operability, and cost assumptions
* Lead migration readiness and technical governance forums such as ARB, WAR, etc., driving Go/No\-Go decisions and coordinating cutover, rollback, business validation, warranty, and service acceptance
* Collaborate with client business, security, infrastructure, application, data, and operations leaders to convert technical constraints into clear business impacts and decisions
* Set up delivery metrics covering migration throughput, schedule variance, defect leakage, cutover success, availability, performance, cloud spend, and benefits realization
* Champion adoption of cloud governance and FinOps practices, encompassing policy, tagging, cost allocation, budget controls, rightsizing, and optimization backlogs
* Contribute to presales, estimates, solution shaping, delivery assurance, account growth, and capability development, while mentoring delivery managers and technical leads
* Apply approved enterprise GenAI tools responsibly to enhance planning, reporting, risk analysis, knowledge management, and stakeholder communication while safeguarding data and intellectual property


**Requirements**
* Between 9 and 17 years of IT delivery experience, with at least 5 years leading substantial cloud transformation, application modernization, infrastructure, or migration programmes, plus experience overseeing multiple workstreams, senior stakeholders, and program execution through Agile \& Hybrid methodologies
* Understanding of GCP resource hierarchy (organizations, folders, projects), IAM, VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, Cloud KMS, and backup/DR concepts
* Awareness of migration strategy patterns such as rehost, replatform, and refactor
* Capability to oversee identity, network segmentation, key management, logging, vulnerability remediation, backup/DR, business continuity, and regulatory requirements
* Proficiency in RAID management, financial governance, change control, and executive reporting
* Practical knowledge of project tracking systems (Jira/Confluence/ADO/Project) and application of Gen AI tools for Delivery Management
* Grasp of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), containers/Kubernetes (GKE), APIs, integration patterns, and SRE/observability fundamentals
* Skill in facilitating architecture reviews and communicating technical trade\-offs, costs, risks, and migration decisions to both business and engineering audiences


**Nice to have**
* Hands\-on exposure to Google Cloud Architecture Framework, Cloud Foundation Toolkit, and foundation/landing\-zone build\-outs, coupled with familiarity in Google's structured migration methodologies
* Holding a recognized Google Cloud credential such as Digital Leader or Professional Cloud Architect, or a comparable industry\-accepted certification
* Possession of programme\-management credentials like PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, ITIL, or similar recognized qualifications

**Job Title: Senior Principal Technical Program Manager \- India**
 At Providence, we use our voice to advocate for vulnerable populations and needed reforms in health care. We pursue innovative ways to transform health care by keeping people healthy, and making our services more convenient, accessible and affordable for all. In an increasingly uncertain world, we are committed to high\-quality; compassionate health care for everyone—regardless of coverage or ability to pay. We help people and communities’ benefit from the best health care model for the future today.
   

  

 Together, our 119,000\-plus caregivers/employees serve in 51 hospitals, more than 1000 clinics and a comprehensive range of health and social services across Alaska, California, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas and Washington in United States.
   

  

 Providence has recently launched its Global Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India as Global Technology \& Engineering Capability Centre looking to leverage the India talent to help meet our global vision and scale our Information Services and products to the world of Cloud. We deliver our vision \- “Health for a Better World” by creating health systems of the future, building bridges for healthier communities, and providing clinical excellence by nurturing a spirit of innovation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a dynamic
 **Senior Principal Technical Program Manager** 
 to drive the end\-to\-end provider credentialing capability for large health systems. The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of end\-to\-end provider credentialing operations, regulatory compliance, payer enrollment processes, and program delivery management.
   

  

 You will be responsible for setting up the COE for the provider credentialing capability with end\-to\-end technology solutions.
   

  

 Effective executive stakeholder engagement, building roadmaps, influencing the balance of scope\-budget\-timelines, strategic planning, and demonstrating agile expertise with functional\-technical\-operational processes are some of the other key capabilities for this role. An ideal candidate will have strong intellectual curiosity along with an optimistic outlook towards challenges.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technology strategy:** 
 Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the technology solutions in Provider Credentialing. I mplement automation and AI\-driven solutions to improve credentialing productivity and accuracy.
   

  

* Requirements Gathering \& Prioritization: Work with stakeholders (HR, recruitment teams, customers, and leadership) to define solution requirements and prioritize features that align with business objectives. Balance short\-term deliverables with long\-term strategic goals.
* Process Improvement \& Transformation: Identify opportunities for workflow optimizations and operation efficiencies.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, UX/UI, marketing, and customer support teams to ensure timely and high\-quality product releases.
* Innovation \& Competitive Analysis: Keep a close eye on market trends, competitor offerings, and new technologies.

* People Development: Provide coaching, growth opportunities, and professional development in the credentialing capability. Exposure to domain trainings across the team.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for senior leadership, effectively communicating product strategies, progress, and roadmaps. Represent product strategy in leadership meetings.


**Metrics \& Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* Define key metrics for solution performance, including user adoption, engagement, retention, and revenue growth.
* Own the solution success by regularly tracking performance against KPIs and making data\-driven decisions to improve product performance.
* Should be a thought leader and drive the technology innovation agenda through collaboration with product development and other stake holders
* The position is based in Hyderabad and requires collaboration with global teams in different time zones.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* Experience: Minimum 12\+ years of experience in product management, with at least 5\+ years in leading provider solutions.
* Provider Credentialing Functional Experience: Strong understanding of end\-to\-end provider credentialing, onboarding, primary source verification, CAQH, NPPES, Privileging \& payer rostering and enrollments.

**Desired Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Provider Solutions like onboarding, recruiting, credentialing.
* Experience with Engineering and product development.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based HR tools and the latest innovations in recruitment technologies.
* Data\-driven mindset with proficiency in using analytics tools to monitor and assess product performance.

* Comfortable using tools such as Azure DevOPs, GitHub and identify meaningful insights

* Established background in launching software or services with high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development, understanding of Agile principles

9866c71a.title: Senior Program Manager, Mapping Operations
9866c71a.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states.
   

  

 The Mapping Operations team is responsible for building, validating, and continuously improving the high\-definition maps that power Waymo’s autonomous driving system. The team ensures that the vehicle has an accurate, up\-to\-date understanding of the world by transforming raw sensor data into reliable, production\-ready map assets. The team sits at the intersection of autonomous driving, and scaled operations, partnering closely with Engineering, ML, and Product teams to support safe, scalable deployment across new and existing markets. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager in Hyderabad to lead one of the large Production teams, partner closely with cross\-functional stakeholders \& vendor teams, and help build best\-in\-class operations.
   

  

**You Will**

* Identify process improvement opportunities and implement initiatives to raise the bar on productivity and quality
* Lead strategic initiatives involving tooling, process, and infrastructure that help scale the organization
* Manage large projects from concept to launch by developing realistic project estimates and coordinating with stakeholders including Engineering, Product and Operations
* Monitor, measure and communicate project progress and team performance to program teams, and executive leadership
* Provide mentorship/ managerial support for junior team members


**You Have**
* Bachelor's Degree in technical or business discipline
* Overall 12\+ years of work experience managing large\-scale and dynamic programs
* At least 4 years of direct people management experience
* Experience working with and managing scaled vendor operations teams
* Proven collaboration and communications skills working with globally distributed teams and multiple stakeholders
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive actionable insights from complex data


**We Prefer**
* MBA preferred
* Ability to effectively operate with high energy and flexibility in a fast\-paced, constantly evolving team environment
* Technical proficiency to engage credibly with engineering stakeholders
* Familiarity with SQL or Dremel scripting for data analysis


**Provide Travel Requirements (if Applicable)**
* Ability to travel to the US as needed


 The expected base salary range for this full\-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job\-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.
   

  

 Salary Range
   

  

 ₹7,000,000—₹8,350,000 INR

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Programme Manager (TPM)
 



**About the Role** 




 Our vision is to enable colleagues to consume, share and communicate efficiently through a seamless experience. The role will ensure we support our strategic outcomes to transform tasks into a dynamic platform supporting all elements \- from the process in store, to the applications used and the devices, creating a better connected and more efficient workforce.
 



 This is an opportunity for an experienced Technical Programme Manager to lead the programme and build out new capability and functions within the platform across Tesco Group, delivering a step change within our business.
 



 As a TPM for Stores Operations Programmes, you will play a pivotal role working with the Product Managers, business stakeholders, Engineering teams, third parties and other Technology and Programme family members to define and deliver the change to embed new technology into our stores making them ready for the future.
 



**You will need** 




 Required skills:
 


* A proven record of accomplishment in delivering technology software
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrate resilience during incidents or change and continue delivery
* Strong Project, Stakeholder \& Programme management skills, including:\-
* Initiating and shaping programmes with substantial ambiguity, across multiple domains
* Building and managing plans, with clear transition states/phases, milestones \& critical path
* Proactively identifying issues, risks \& dependencies, working closely with Product and Engineering teams to resolve, mitigate, transparently track and make visible
* Understanding the trade\-offs and resulting impacts; making impacts visible to Product, Infrastructure or Engineering for the right decision to be made



 Desired skills:
 


* Experience of working with multiple teams to deliver expected outcomes
* Experience of working with suppliers and 3rd parties
* Finance Management
